question_mn: ТУЗ-ийн түвшинд шийдвэрлэгдсэн хүсэлтүүдийн дугаар, хүссэн дүн, валют, төлөвийг жагсаа
question_latin: TUZ-iin tvwshind shiidwerlegdsen hvseltvvdiin dugaar, hvssen dvn, walyut, tuluwiig jagsaa
question_en: List the application number, requested amount, currency and status of the applications decided at board level.
gold_sql: SELECT application_no, requested_amount, currency_code, status_name FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE decision_level = 'BOARD'

question_mn: 2025 онд харилцагч өөрөө буцаан татсан хүсэлт хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond khariltsagch ooroo butsaan tatsan khuselt khed baisan be?
question_en: How many applications submitted in 2025 were withdrawn by the customers themselves?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_applications FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE status_code = 'WITHDRAWN' AND submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
notes: буцаан татсан хүсэлтэд шийдвэрийн огноо байхгүй тул илгээсэн огноогоор

question_mn: Татгалзсан хүсэлтүүдийн дундаас хамгийн өндөр скорингийн оноо хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: Tatgalzsan hvseltvvdiin dundaas hamgiin undur skoringiin onoo hed baisan be
question_en: What was the highest credit score among rejected applications?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(credit_score) AS max_score FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE status_code = 'REJECTED'

question_mn: Хөдөө аж ахуйн зориулалттай төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдэд дунджаар хэдэн төгрөг хүссэн бэ?
question_latin: Huduu aj ahuin zoriulalttai tugrugiin hvseltvvded dundjaar heden tugrug hvssen be?
question_en: On average, how much was requested in MNT-denominated applications for agricultural purposes?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(requested_amount), 2) AS avg_requested FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE purpose_category = 'AGRICULTURE' AND currency_code = 'MNT'

question_mn: Төгрөгөөр 100 саяас дээш дүн хүссэн хүсэлт хэд байгаа вэ?
question_latin: Togrogoor 100 saya-aas deesh dun khussen khuselt khed baigaa ve?
question_en: How many MNT-denominated applications requested more than 100 million?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND requested_amount > 100000000

question_mn: Энэ сард шийдвэр гарсан хүсэлтүүдийн DTI дунджаар хэд байв?
question_latin: Ene sard shiidver garsan khuseltuudiin DTI dundjaar khed baiv?
question_en: What was the average DTI of applications decided this month?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(dti_ratio), 2) AS avg_dti FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE decided_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Дуудлагын төвөөр ирсэн хүсэлтүүдэд дунджаар хэдэн сарын хугацаа хүссэн байдаг вэ?
question_latin: Duudlagiin tuwuur irsen hvseltvvded dundjaar heden sariin hugatsaa hvssen baidag we?
question_en: What is the average requested term, in months, of applications received through the call center?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(requested_term_months), 2) AS avg_requested_term FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE channel = 'CALL_CENTER'

question_mn: Энэ онд барьцаа хөрөнгө хангалтгүй гэсэн шалтгаанаар хэдэн хүсэлтийг татгалзсан бэ?
question_latin: ene ond baritsaa hurungu hangaltgvi gesen shaltgaanaar heden hvseltiig tatgalzsan be
question_en: How many applications have been rejected this year because of insufficient collateral?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rejected_applications FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE status_code = 'REJECTED' AND rejection_reason = 'Барьцаа хөрөнгө хангалтгүй' AND decided_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийг зээлийн зориулалтаар нь бүлэглэж, хүсэлтийн тоо болон хүссэн дүнгийн медианыг гарга. Зориулалтаа бөглөөгүй хүсэлтийг тооцохгүй.
question_latin: Togrogiin khuseltuudiig zeeliin zoriulaltaar ni buleglej, khuseltiin too bolon khussen dungiin medianiig garga. Zoriulaltaa bogloogui khuseltiig tootsokhgui.
question_en: Group MNT applications by loan purpose and show the number of applications and the median requested amount; exclude applications without a stated purpose.
gold_sql: SELECT purpose_category, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY requested_amount)::numeric, 2) AS median_requested FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND purpose_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY purpose_category

question_mn: Эрэгтэй, эмэгтэй харилцагчдын зээлийн хүсэлтийн зөвшөөрлийн хувь ямар байна? Хүйсээр нь харьцуул.
question_latin: Eregtei, emegtei hariltsagchdiin zeeliin hvseltiin zuwshuurliin huwi yamar baina? Hviseer ni haritsuul.
question_en: What is the loan application approval rate of male versus female customers? Compare by gender.
question_mixed: Male, female харилцагчдын approval rate-ийг gender-ээр нь харьцуул
gold_sql: SELECT i.gender, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY i.gender

question_mn: Хувь хүн хүсэлт гаргагчдыг насаар нь 30 хүртэл, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60 ба түүнээс дээш гэж ангилаад ангилал бүрийн хүсэлтийн тоо, зөвшөөрлийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: Khuvi khun khuselt gargagchdiig nasaar ni 30 khurtel, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 ba tuunees deesh gej angilaad angilal buriin khuseltiin too, zovshoorliin khuviig garga
question_en: Group individual applicants into age bands (under 30, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 and over) and show the number of applications and the approval rate for each band.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.age < 30 THEN '30 хүртэл' WHEN i.age < 40 THEN '30-39' WHEN i.age < 50 THEN '40-49' WHEN i.age < 60 THEN '50-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Харилцагчийн төрөл тус бүрээс ирсэн хүсэлтийн тоо болон татгалзсан хувийг гаргаж өгөөч
question_latin: hariltsagchiin turul tus bvrees irsen hvseltiin too bolon tatgalzsan huwiig gargaj uguuch
question_en: Give me the number of applications and the rejection rate for each customer type.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type_name, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code = 'REJECTED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS rejection_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_type_name

question_mn: Энэ онд Улаанбаатарын болон орон нутгийн салбаруудад ирсэн төгрөгийн хүсэлтийн тоо, дундаж хүссэн дүнг харьцуулж гарга
question_latin: Ene ond Ulaanbaatariin bolon oron nutgiin salbaruudad irsen togrogiin khuseltiin too, dundaj khussen dung kharitsuulj garga
question_en: Compare the number of MNT applications and the average requested amount this year between Ulaanbaatar branches and rural branches.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.province = 'Улаанбаатар' THEN 'Улаанбаатар' ELSE 'Орон нутаг' END AS region, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(AVG(a.requested_amount), 2) AS avg_requested FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.currency_code = 'MNT' AND a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Энэ сард 10 ба түүнээс дээш хүсэлт хүлээж авсан зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдийн нэр, хүсэлтийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Ene sard 10 ba tvvnees deesh hvselt hvleej awsan zeeliin mergejiltnvvdiin ner, hvseltiin toog garga
question_en: Show the names and application counts of loan officers who received 10 or more applications this month.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.loan_officer_id WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

question_mn: Скорингийн зөвлөмж тус бүрээр хэдэн хүсэлт батлагдаж, хэд нь татгалзагдсаныг гарга
question_latin: skoringiin zovlomj tus bureer kheden khuselt batlagdaj, khed ni tatgalzagdsaniig garga
question_en: For each scoring recommendation, show how many applications were approved and how many were rejected.
gold_sql: SELECT s.decision_hint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) AS approved, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code = 'REJECTED') AS rejected FROM t2s.credit_scores s JOIN t2s.loan_applications a ON a.application_id = s.application_id GROUP BY s.decision_hint

question_mn: Скорингийн модель бүрээр дундаж оноо болон дундаж дефолтын магадлалыг хувиар гарга
question_latin: Skoringiin modeli bvreer dundaj onoo bolon dundaj defoltiin magadlaliig huwiar garga
question_en: Show the average score and the average probability of default, in percent, for each scoring model.
question_mixed: Scoring model бүрээр average score болон average PD-г %-иар гарга
gold_sql: SELECT model_name, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(pd_estimate), 2) AS avg_pd_pct FROM t2s.credit_scores GROUP BY model_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард долоо хоног бүр (даваа гарагаас эхэлсэн) хэдэн хүсэлт ирснийг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard doloo honog bvr (dawaa garagaas ehelsen) heden hvselt irsniig garga
question_en: Show how many applications came in each week (weeks starting on Monday) in June 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', submitted_date)::date AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд шийдвэр гарсан хүсэлтүүдийн хэдэн хувьд нь шийдвэр гаргахад 7-оос олон хоног зарцуулсныг салбар бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Ene ond shiidver garsan khuseltuudiin kheden khuvid ni shiidver gargakhad 7-oos olon khonog zartsuulsniig salbar bureer garga
question_en: For applications decided this year, show by branch the percentage that took more than 7 days to decide.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.decided_date - a.submitted_date > 7) / COUNT(*), 2) AS over_7_days_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.decided_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Харилцагчдыг гаргасан хүсэлтийнх нь тоогоор 1, 2, 3 ба түүнээс олон гэж бүлэглээд бүлэг бүрт хэдэн харилцагч байгааг гарга
question_latin: Khariltsagchdiig gargasan khuseltiinkh ni toogoor 1, 2, 3 ba tuunees olon gej bulegleed buleg burt kheden khariltsagch baigaag garga
question_en: Group customers by how many applications they have submitted (1, 2, 3 or more) and show how many customers fall into each group.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN '1' WHEN n = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS applications_band, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY customer_id) t GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Шийдвэр хүлээж буй хүсэлтүүд төлөв бүрээр хэд байна, илгээгдээд дунджаар хэдэн хоног хүлээгдэж байна вэ?
question_latin: Shiidwer hvleej bui hvseltvvd tuluw bvreer hed baina, ilgeegdeed dundjaar heden honog hvleegdej baina we?
question_en: For each pending status, how many applications are awaiting a decision and how many days on average have they been waiting since submission?
gold_sql: SELECT status_name, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(AVG(CURRENT_DATE - submitted_date), 2) AS avg_days_waiting FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE status_code IN ('SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'PENDING_DOCS') GROUP BY status_name
notes: шийдвэр хүлээж буй = илгээгдсэн, судалгаанд, баримт хүлээгдэж буй

question_mn: Харилцагчийн эрсдэлийн түвшингээс хамаараад хүсэлтийн зөвшөөрлийн хувь хэрхэн ялгаатай байна вэ?
question_latin: Hariltsagchiin ersdeliin tvwshingees hamaaraad hvseltiin zuwshuurliin huwi herhen yalgaatai baina we?
question_en: How does the application approval rate differ by customer risk level?
gold_sql: SELECT c.risk_level, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.risk_level

question_mn: Өнгөрсөн жил ирсэн төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийн дундаж хүссэн дүн болон батлагдсан хүсэлтүүдийн дундаж батлагдсан дүнг суваг тус бүрээр гаргаж өг
question_latin: ongorson jil irsen togrogiin khuseltuudiin dundaj khussen dun bolon batlagdsan khuseltuudiin dundaj batlagdsan dung suvag tus bureer gargaj og
question_en: For MNT applications received last year, give the average requested amount and, for approved applications, the average approved amount, by channel.
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(AVG(requested_amount), 2) AS avg_requested, ROUND(AVG(approved_amount) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')), 2) AS avg_approved FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY channel
notes: өнгөрсөн жил = 2025; батлагдсан = APPROVED, CONTRACTED, EXPIRED

question_mn: Хар жагсаалтад орсон харилцагчдаас нийт хэдэн хүсэлт ирсэн бэ, үүнээс хэд нь батлагдсан бэ?
question_latin: Har jagsaaltad orson hariltsagchdaas niit heden hvselt irsen be, vvnees hed ni batlagdsan be?
question_en: How many applications came from blacklisted customers in total, and how many of them were approved?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) AS approved FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.is_blacklisted

question_mn: Сүүлийн 3 сарын (4, 5, 6-р сар) скорингийн дундаж оноог сар бүрээр харуул
question_latin: Suuliin 3 sariin (4, 5, 6-r sar) skoringiin dundaj onoog sar bureer kharuul
question_en: Show the average credit score for each of the last three months (April, May and June).
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', scored_date)::date AS month, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE scored_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2026 онд шийдвэр гарсан хүсэлтүүдийн шийдвэр гарах хугацааны медиан болон 90-р перцентилийг (хоногоор) суваг бүрээр гарга
question_latin: 2026 ond shiidwer garsan hvseltvvdiin shiidwer garah hugatsaanii median bolon 90-r pertsentiliig (honogoor) suwag bvreer garga
question_en: For applications decided in 2026, show by channel the median and the 90th percentile of the time to decision, in days.
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decided_date - submitted_date)::numeric, 2) AS median_days, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decided_date - submitted_date)::numeric, 2) AS p90_days FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE decided_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel

question_mn: Төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийг хүссэн дүнгээр нь 10 саяас доош, 10–50 сая, 50 сая ба түүнээс дээш гэж ангилаад ангилал бүрийн хүсэлтийн тоо, зөвшөөрлийн хувь, шийдвэр гарах дундаж хоногийг гарга
question_latin: tugrugiin hvseltvvdiig hvssen dvngeer ni 10 sayaas doosh, 10-50 saya, 50 saya ba tvvnees deesh gej angilaad angilal bvriin hvseltiin too, zuwshuurliin huwi, shiidwer garah dundaj honogiig garga
question_en: Classify MNT applications by requested amount (under 10 million, 10-50 million, 50 million and above) and show, for each class, the number of applications, the approval rate and the average days to decision.
question_mixed: Төгрөгийн application-уудыг requested amount-аар (10 саяас доош, 10–50 сая, 50 сая+) ангилаад application count, approval rate, decision хүртэлх average хоногийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN requested_amount < 10000000 THEN '10 саяас доош' WHEN requested_amount < 50000000 THEN '10-50 сая' ELSE '50 сая+' END AS amount_band, COUNT(*) AS applications, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate, ROUND(AVG(decided_date - submitted_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_decision FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY 1
notes: шийдвэр гараагүй хүсэлтийн хугацаа NULL тул дунджид орохгүй

question_mn: Татгалзуулсныхаа дараа дахин хүсэлт гаргаж батлуулсан харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Tatgalzuulsniikhaa daraa dakhin khuselt gargaj batluulsan khariltsagch khed baina?
question_en: How many customers had an application rejected and later submitted another application that was approved?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS customers FROM t2s.loan_applications r WHERE r.status_code = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_applications a WHERE a.customer_id = r.customer_id AND a.submitted_date > r.submitted_date AND a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED'))

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн хүсэлтийн тоо болон тухайн сарыг оролцуулсан сүүлийн 3 сарын хөдөлгөөнт дунджийг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii sar bvriin hvseltiin too bolon tuhain sariig oroltsuulsan svvliin 3 sariin hudulguunt dundjiig garga
question_en: Show the monthly number of applications in 2026 together with the 3-month moving average including the current month.
question_mixed: 2026 оны month бүрийн application count болон 3 сарын moving average-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', submitted_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), w AS (SELECT month, applications, ROUND(AVG(applications) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m FROM m) SELECT month, applications, moving_avg_3m FROM w WHERE month >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY month

question_mn: Хүсэлтүүдийг скорингийн оноогоор нь 10 тэнцүү бүлэгт хуваагаад (1-р бүлэг нь хамгийн бага оноотой) бүлэг бүрийн хамгийн бага, хамгийн их оноо болон зөвшөөрлийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: Khuseltuudiig skoringiin onoogoor ni 10 tentsuu bulegt khuvaagaad (1-r buleg ni khamgiin baga onootoi) buleg buriin khamgiin baga, khamgiin ikh onoo bolon zovshoorliin khuviig garga
question_en: Split applications into 10 equal groups by credit score (group 1 = lowest scores) and show each group's minimum score, maximum score and approval rate.
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT credit_score, status_code, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY credit_score, application_id) AS decile FROM t2s.loan_applications) SELECT decile, MIN(credit_score) AS min_score, MAX(credit_score) AS max_score, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM d GROUP BY decile ORDER BY decile

question_mn: Энэ улиралд батлагдсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтийн дүнгээр тэргүүлсэн 5 зээлийн мэргэжилтэн, тэдний батлуулсан нийт дүн болон бүх батлагдсан дүнд эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: ene ulirald batlagdsan tugrugiin hvseltiin dvngeer tergvvlsen 5 zeeliin mergejilten, tednii batluulsan niit dvn bolon bvh batlagdsan dvnd ezleh huwiig garga
question_en: Show the top 5 loan officers by approved MNT application amount this quarter, with their total approved amount and its share of all approved amounts.
question_mixed: Энэ quarter-т approve болсон төгрөгийн дүнгээр top 5 loan officer, approved amount болон share %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT a.loan_officer_id, SUM(a.approved_amount) AS approved_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications a WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') AND a.currency_code = 'MNT' AND a.decided_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY a.loan_officer_id), s AS (SELECT loan_officer_id, approved_amount, ROUND(100.0 * approved_amount / SUM(approved_amount) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM o) SELECT e.full_name, s.approved_amount, s.share_pct FROM s JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = s.loan_officer_id ORDER BY s.approved_amount DESC, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр энэ улиралд ирсэн хүсэлтийн тоог өмнөх улирлынхтай харьцуулж, хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: Salbar bvreer ene ulirald irsen hvseltiin toog umnuh ulirliinhtai haritsuulj, heden huwiar uurchlugdsuniig garga
question_en: For each branch, compare the number of applications received this quarter with the previous quarter and show the percentage change.
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31') AS prev_quarter, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS this_quarter FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, prev_quarter, this_quarter, ROUND(100.0 * (this_quarter - prev_quarter) / NULLIF(prev_quarter, 0), 2) AS change_pct FROM q

question_mn: 2025 онд суваг бүрийн хувьд зөвшөөрлийн хувь хамгийн өндөр байсан улирал аль вэ? Суваг, улирал, зөвшөөрлийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond suvag buriin khuvid zovshoorliin khuvi khamgiin ondor baisan uliral ali ve? Suvag, uliral, zovshoorliin khuviig garga
question_en: In 2025, which quarter had the highest approval rate for each channel? Show the channel, the quarter and the approval rate.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT channel, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM submitted_date)::int AS quarter, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, 2), x AS (SELECT channel, quarter, approval_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY approval_rate DESC NULLS LAST, quarter) AS rn FROM r) SELECT channel, quarter, approval_rate FROM x WHERE rn = 1

question_mn: 2025 онд 20-оос доошгүй хүсэлтэд нь шийдвэр гарсан зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдээс зөвшөөрлийн хувь нь өөрийн салбарын түвшнээс 10 нэгж хувиас илүү доогуур байсан хүмүүсийн нэр, салбар, өөрийнх нь болон салбарын зөвшөөрлийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond 20-oos dooshgvi hvselted ni shiidwer garsan zeeliin mergejiltnvvdees zuwshuurliin huwi ni uuriin salbariin tvwshnees 10 negj huwias ilvv dooguur baisan hvmvvsiin ner, salbar, uuriinh ni bolon salbariin zuwshuurliin huwiig garga
question_en: Among loan officers with at least 20 decided applications in 2025, show those whose approval rate was more than 10 percentage points below their branch's rate: name, branch, their own approval rate and the branch approval rate.
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT a.branch_id, a.loan_officer_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) AS approved, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')) AS decided FROM t2s.loan_applications a WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY a.branch_id, a.loan_officer_id), b AS (SELECT branch_id, 100.0 * SUM(approved) / NULLIF(SUM(decided), 0) AS branch_rate FROM o GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT e.full_name, br.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * o.approved / o.decided, 2) AS officer_rate, ROUND(b.branch_rate, 2) AS branch_rate FROM o JOIN b ON b.branch_id = o.branch_id JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = o.loan_officer_id JOIN t2s.branches br ON br.branch_id = o.branch_id WHERE o.decided >= 20 AND 100.0 * o.approved / o.decided < b.branch_rate - 10
notes: салбарын хувь = тухайн салбарт ирсэн бүх хүсэлтээр

question_mn: Нэг харилцагчийн дараалсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийг харьцуулахад, давтан хүсэлтүүдийн хэдэн хувьд нь өмнөх хүсэлтээсээ их дүн хүссэн бэ?
question_latin: neg khariltsagchiin daraalsan togrogiin khuseltuudiig kharitsuulakhad, davtan khuseltuudiin kheden khuvid ni omnokh khuselteesee ikh dun khussen be?
question_en: Comparing each customer's consecutive MNT applications, in what percentage of repeat applications was the requested amount higher than in the previous application?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT requested_amount, LAG(requested_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY submitted_date, application_id) AS prev_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE requested_amount > prev_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS higher_request_pct FROM x
notes: давтан хүсэлт = харилцагчийн 2 дахь болон түүнээс хойших төгрөгийн хүсэлт

question_mn: Өнгөрсөн оны сар бүрийн зөвшөөрлийн хувь болон өмнөх сараасаа хэдэн нэгж хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: Ungursun onii sar bvriin zuwshuurliin huwi bolon umnuh saraasaa heden negj huwiar uurchlugdsuniig garga
question_en: Show last year's monthly approval rate and its change in percentage points from the previous month.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', submitted_date)::date AS month, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0) AS rate FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2024-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT month, rate, rate - LAG(rate) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_pp FROM m) SELECT month, ROUND(rate, 2) AS approval_rate, ROUND(change_pp, 2) AS change_pp FROM c WHERE month >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY month

question_mn: Энэ онд хийгдсэн скорингуудыг эрсдэлийн зэрэглэлээр нь тоолж, зэрэглэл бүр нийт скорингийн хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байгааг гарга
question_latin: Ene ond hiigdsen skoringuudiig ersdeliin zeregleleer ni toolj, zereglel bvr niit skoringiin heden huwiig ezelj baigaag garga
question_en: Count this year's credit scores by risk grade and show what percentage of all scores each grade accounts for.
gold_sql: SELECT risk_grade_name, COUNT(*) AS scores, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE scored_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY risk_grade_name

question_mn: Энэ онд ирсэн хүсэлтүүдийн зөвшөөрлийн хувийг харилцагчийн сегмент, салбарын байршил (Улаанбаатар эсвэл орон нутаг) хоёроор задалж гарга
question_latin: Ene ond irsen khuseltuudiin zovshoorliin khuviig khariltsagchiin segment, salbariin bairshil (Ulaanbaatar esvel oron nutag) khoyoroor zadalj garga
question_en: Break down this year's application approval rate by customer segment and branch location (Ulaanbaatar or rural).
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, CASE WHEN b.province = 'Улаанбаатар' THEN 'Улаанбаатар' ELSE 'Орон нутаг' END AS region, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED','REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1, 2

question_mn: Яаралтай гэсэн ач холбогдолтой барагдуулалтын кейс хэд байна?
question_latin: Yaraltai gesen ach holbogdoltoi baragduulaltiin keis hed baina?
question_en: How many collection cases have urgent priority?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS urgent_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE priority = 'URGENT'

question_mn: Шүүхийн шатны кейсүүд одоо дунджаар хэдэн хоног хэтэрсэн байна?
question_latin: Shuukhiin shatnii keisuud odoo dundjaar kheden khonog kheterssen baina?
question_en: On average, how many days past due are the cases in the court stage now?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(current_dpd), 2) AS avg_current_dpd FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE stage_code = 'LEGAL'

question_mn: Дуудлагаар холбогдоход буруу дугаар гарсан тохиолдол хэд вэ
question_latin: Duudlagaar holbogdohod buruu dugaar garsan tohioldol hed we
question_en: How many calls ended with a wrong number result?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wrong_number_calls FROM t2s.collection_actions WHERE channel = 'CALL' AND contact_result = 'WRONG_NUMBER'

question_mn: Одоо хамгийн их хоног хэтэрсэн нээлттэй кейсийн дугаар болон хэтэрсэн хоногийг хэл.
question_latin: Odoo khamgiin ikh khonog kheterssen neelttei keisiin dugaar bolon kheterssen khonogiig khel.
question_en: Give the case number and days past due of the open case that is currently most overdue.
gold_sql: SELECT case_no, current_dpd FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') ORDER BY current_dpd DESC, case_no LIMIT 1

question_mn: Нээлттэй кейстэй давхардаагүй хэдэн харилцагч байна?
question_latin: Neelttei keistei dawhardaagvi heden hariltsagch baina?
question_en: How many distinct customers have an open collection case?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')

question_mn: Нээлттэй кейсүүдийг ач холбогдлоор нь ангилаад тоо, одоогийн дундаж хэтрэлтийн хоногийг гарга
question_latin: Neelttei keisvvdiig ach holbogdloor ni angilaad too, odoogiin dundaj hetreltiin honogiig garga
question_en: Break down open cases by priority with their count and average current days past due.
gold_sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS open_cases, ROUND(AVG(current_dpd), 2) AS avg_current_dpd FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY priority

question_mn: Барагдуулалтын шат бүрээр төлөх амлалтын биелэлтийн хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Baragduulaltiin shat buriig tolokh amlaltiin bielteliin khuviig garga.
question_en: Show the promise-to-pay kept rate by collection stage.
gold_sql: SELECT c.stage_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'KEPT') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('KEPT', 'PARTIALLY_KEPT', 'BROKEN')), 0), 2) AS kept_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_promises p JOIN t2s.collection_cases c ON c.case_id = p.case_id GROUP BY c.stage_name

question_mn: Хэсэгчлэн биелсэн төгрөгийн амлалтуудад амласан дүнгийн хэдэн хувийг бодитоор төлсөн бэ?
question_latin: Hesegchlen bielsen tugrugiin amlaltuudad amlasan dvngiin heden huviig boditoor tulsun be?
question_en: For partially kept MNT promises, what percentage of the promised amount was actually paid?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(paid_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(promised_amount), 0), 2) AS paid_pct FROM t2s.collection_promises WHERE status = 'PARTIALLY_KEPT' AND currency_code = 'MNT'

question_mn: 2025 онд шүүхэд нэхэмжлэл гаргасан тоог сар сараар нь харуул
question_latin: 2025 ond shuukhed nekhemjlel gargasan toog sar saraar ni kharuul
question_en: Show the number of court filings per month in 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', action_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS court_filings FROM t2s.collection_actions WHERE action_code = 'COURT_FILING' AND action_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрээс гэрээт барагдуулагч компанид хэдэн кейс шилжүүлснийг салбарын нэрээр гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvreer geree baragduulagch kompanid heden keis shiljvvlsniig salbariin nereer garga.
question_en: Show, by branch name, how many cases were transferred to contracted collection agencies.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS agency_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.agency_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Барагдуулалтын үйлдлийн нийт зардлыг гэрээт компани тус бүр болон дотоод багаар нь задалж гарга.
question_latin: Baragduulaltiin vildliin niit zardliig geree kompani tus bvr bolon dotood bagaar ni zadalj garga.
question_en: Break down total collection action costs by each contracted agency and the in-house team.
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(agency_code, 'IN_HOUSE') AS handler, SUM(cost_amount) AS total_cost FROM t2s.collection_actions GROUP BY COALESCE(agency_code, 'IN_HOUSE')

question_mn: Ирэх 30 хоногт дахин үнэлгээ хийх ёстой идэвхтэй барьцааг төрөл бүрээр тоолж өг
question_latin: Irekh 30 khonogt dakhin unelgee khiikh yostoi idevkhtei bariltsaag torol buriig toolj og
question_en: Count, by collateral type, the active collaterals due for revaluation in the next 30 days.
gold_sql: SELECT collateral_type_name, COUNT(*) AS collaterals FROM t2s.collaterals WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_valuation_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 30 GROUP BY collateral_type_name

question_mn: Батлан даагчийн төрөл бүрээр идэвхтэй батлан даалтын нийт дүнг төгрөгөөр гарга (ам.долларыг өнөөдрийн ханшаар)
question_latin: Batlan daagchiin turul bvreer idewhtei batlan daaltiin niit dvng tugruguur garga (am.dollariig unuudriin hanshaar)
question_en: Show the total active guarantee amount by guarantor type in MNT (USD converted at today's rate).
gold_sql: SELECT guarantor_type, ROUND(SUM(guarantee_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)), 2) AS guarantee_mnt FROM t2s.loan_guarantors WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY guarantor_type

question_mn: Идэвхтэй барьцааг сүүлд үнэлснээс хойш дунджаар хэдэн хоног өнгөрснийг барьцааны төрөл бүрээр харуул
question_latin: Idewhtei baritsaag svvld vnelsnees hoish dundjaar heden honog ungursniig baritsaanii turul bvreer haruul
question_en: By collateral type, show the average number of days since the last valuation of active collaterals.
gold_sql: SELECT collateral_type_name, ROUND(AVG(CURRENT_DATE - valuation_date), 2) AS avg_days_since_valuation FROM t2s.collaterals WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY collateral_type_name

question_mn: Нээлттэй кейсүүдийг одоогийн хэтрэлтээр нь 0–30, 31–90, 91–180, 180-аас дээш хоног гэж бүлэглээд тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Neelttei keisvvdiig odoogiin hetreltees ni 0-30, 31-90, 91-180, 180-aas deesh honog gej bvlegleed toolj garga.
question_en: Group open cases by current days past due (0–30, 31–90, 91–180, over 180) and count them.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN current_dpd <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN current_dpd <= 90 THEN '31-90' WHEN current_dpd <= 180 THEN '91-180' ELSE '180+' END AS dpd_group, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY 1

question_mn: 20-оос олон нээлттэй кейс хариуцаж байгаа барагдуулагчдын нэр, кейсийн тоог жагсаа.
question_latin: 20-oos olon neelttei keis khariutsaj baigaa baragduulagchdiin ner, keisiin toog jagsaa.
question_en: List collectors handling more than 20 open cases, with their names and case counts.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, COUNT(*) AS open_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.assigned_to WHERE c.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question_mn: Сүүлийн 30 хоногт ямар төрлийн барагдуулалтын үйлдэл хэд хийгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Suuliin 30 khonogt yamar torliin baragduulaltiin uildel khed khiigdsen be?
question_en: How many collection actions of each type were performed in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT action_name, COUNT(*) AS actions FROM t2s.collection_actions WHERE action_date > CURRENT_DATE - 30 GROUP BY action_name

question_mn: Нээх үеийн үлдэгдлээсээ их буюу тэнцүү дүн цуглуулсан кейс хэд байна, тэдгээрийн хэд нь барагдсан төлөвтэй вэ?
question_latin: Neeh veiin vldegdlees ih buyu tentsvv dvn tsugluulsan keis hed baina, tedgeeriin hed ni baragdsan tuluwtei we?
question_en: How many cases collected an amount at least equal to their outstanding at opening, and how many of those are resolved?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fully_collected, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE collected_amount >= outstanding_at_open

question_mn: Шат бүрээр нэг кейст дунджаар хэдэн барагдуулалтын үйлдэл ногдож байна? Үйлдэлгүй кейсийг 0 гэж тооц.
question_latin: Shat bvreer neg keist dundjaar heden baragduulaltiin vildel nogdoj baina? Vildelgvi keisiig 0 gej toots.
question_en: By stage, how many collection actions are there per case on average? Count cases without actions as 0.
gold_sql: SELECT c.stage_name, ROUND(COUNT(a.action_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id), 2) AS actions_per_case FROM t2s.collection_cases c LEFT JOIN t2s.collection_actions a ON a.case_id = c.case_id GROUP BY c.stage_name

question_mn: Одоогоор нэг ч төлөх амлалт аваагүй нээлттэй кейс хэд байна?
question_latin: Odoogoor neg ch tulukh amlalt awaagvi neelttei keis hed baina?
question_en: How many open cases have not obtained a single promise to pay so far?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases_without_promise FROM t2s.collection_cases c WHERE c.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.collection_promises p WHERE p.case_id = c.case_id)

question_mn: 2024 онд нээгдсэн кейсүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь шүүхийн шатанд хүрсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2024 ond neegdsen keisuudiin kheden khuv ni shuukhiin shatand khursen be?
question_en: What percentage of cases opened in 2024 have reached the court stage?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage_code = 'LEGAL') / COUNT(*), 2) AS legal_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE opened_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'

question_mn: Нэхэмжилсэн батлан даалттай зээлүүдийн барагдуулалтын кейс одоо ямар шатандаа байгааг шатаар нь тоол
question_latin: Nehemjilsen batlan daalttai zeelvvdiin baragduulaltiin keis odoo yamar shatandaa baigaag shataar ni tool
question_en: For loans whose guarantees have been called, count their collection cases by current stage.
gold_sql: SELECT c.stage_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS cases FROM t2s.collection_cases c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_guarantors g WHERE g.loan_id = c.loan_id AND g.status = 'CALLED') GROUP BY c.stage_name

question_mn: Даланзадгад салбарын барагдуулалтын хувь хэд вэ? (кейсүүдээр, төгрөгөөр)
question_latin: Dalanzadgad salbariin baragduulaltiin huwi hed we? (keisvvdeer, tugrugoor)
question_en: What is the collection recovery rate of the Dalanzadgad branch (across its cases, in MNT)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.collected_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(c.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.outstanding_at_open * t2s.fx_to_mnt(c.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)), 0), 2) AS recovery_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE b.branch_name = 'Даланзадгад салбар'
notes: USD cases converted at business-date rate

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний хагаст хамгийн олон кейс барагдуулж хаасан 5 барагдуулагчийг нэр, тоо, байрын хамт гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii ehnii hagast hamgiin olon keis baragduulj haasan 5 baragduulagchiig ner, too, bairiin hamt garga.
question_en: Show the top 5 collectors by number of cases resolved in H1 2026, with name, count and rank.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.full_name, COUNT(*) AS resolved_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.assigned_to WHERE c.status = 'RESOLVED' AND c.closed_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name) SELECT full_name, resolved_cases, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY resolved_cases DESC) AS rnk FROM r ORDER BY resolved_cases DESC, employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Кейс нээгдсэнээс хойш анх удаа төлөх амлалт авсан үйлдэл хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног зарцуулдгийг шат бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Keis neegdsenees khoish ankh udaa tolokh amlalt avsan uildel khurtel dundjaar kheden khonog zartsuuldgiig shat buriig garga.
question_en: By stage, show the average number of days from case opening to the first action in which a promise to pay was obtained.
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT case_id, MIN(action_date) AS first_promise FROM t2s.collection_actions WHERE contact_result = 'PROMISE_OBTAINED' GROUP BY case_id) SELECT c.stage_name, ROUND(AVG(f.first_promise - c.opened_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_promise FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN f ON f.case_id = c.case_id GROUP BY c.stage_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн нээлттэй кейсийн хэдэн хувь нь шүүхийн шатанд байгааг тооцоод, хувиар нь эрэмбэлж байрыг хамт гарга.
question_latin: Salbar buriin neelttei keisiin kheden khuv ni shuukhiin shatand baigaag tootsood, khuviar ni erembelj bairiig khamt garga.
question_en: For each branch, compute the share of open cases in the court stage, ranked by that share, with the rank.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.stage_code = 'LEGAL') / COUNT(*), 2) AS legal_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, legal_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY legal_pct DESC) AS rnk FROM s ORDER BY legal_pct DESC, branch_name

question_mn: Төгрөгийн кейсүүд дээр барагдуулагч бүрийн цуглуулсан дүнг өөрийн гүйцэтгэсэн үйлдлийн зардалд харьцуулаад, нэг төгрөгийн зардалд ногдох цуглуулалтаар шилдэг 5-ыг гарга.
question_latin: Tugrugiin keisvvd deer baragduulagch bvriin tsugluulsan dvng uuriin gvitsetgesen vildliin zardald hariltsuulaad, neg tugrugiin zardald nogdoh tsugluulaltaar shildeg 5-iig garga.
question_en: For MNT cases, compare each collector's collected amount with the cost of actions they performed, and list the top 5 by amount collected per tugrik of cost.
gold_sql: WITH col AS (SELECT assigned_to AS employee_id, SUM(collected_amount) AS collected FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY assigned_to), cost AS (SELECT a.performed_by AS employee_id, SUM(a.cost_amount) AS cost FROM t2s.collection_actions a JOIN t2s.collection_cases c ON c.case_id = a.case_id WHERE c.currency_code = 'MNT' AND a.performed_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.performed_by) SELECT e.full_name, ROUND(col.collected / NULLIF(cost.cost, 0), 2) AS collected_per_cost FROM col JOIN cost ON cost.employee_id = col.employee_id JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = col.employee_id ORDER BY collected_per_cost DESC NULLS LAST, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Шүүхийн шатны нээлттэй төгрөгийн кейсүүдээс идэвхтэй барьцааны хүлээн зөвшөөрөх үнэлгээ нь кейсийн одоогийн үлдэгдлийг бүрэн нөхөж байгаа нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: Shuukhiin shatnii neelttei togrogiin keisuudees idevkhtei bariltsaanii khuleen zovshoorokh unelgee ni keisiin odoogiin uldegdliig buren nokhoj baigaa ni khed ve?
question_en: Among open MNT cases in the court stage, how many have active collateral whose accepted value fully covers the current case outstanding?
gold_sql: WITH col AS (SELECT lc.loan_id, SUM(cl.accepted_value * t2s.fx_to_mnt(cl.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)) AS accepted_mnt FROM t2s.loan_collaterals lc JOIN t2s.collaterals cl ON cl.collateral_id = lc.collateral_id WHERE lc.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lc.loan_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN col ON col.loan_id = c.loan_id WHERE c.stage_code = 'LEGAL' AND c.currency_code = 'MNT' AND c.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') AND col.accepted_mnt >= c.current_outstanding

question_mn: Нээлттэй кейс бүрт хэдэн өөр сувгаар холбогдож оролдсоныг тоолоод, сувгийн тоо тус бүрт хэдэн кейс ногдохыг гарга.
question_latin: Neelttei keis bvrt heden uur suwgaar holbogdoj oroldsoniig toolood, suwgiin too tus bvrt heden keis nogdohiig garga.
question_en: For each open case count the distinct channels used in its actions, then show how many cases fall under each channel count.
gold_sql: WITH n AS (SELECT a.case_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.channel) AS channels FROM t2s.collection_actions a JOIN t2s.collection_cases c ON c.case_id = a.case_id WHERE c.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY a.case_id) SELECT channels, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM n GROUP BY channels ORDER BY channels

question_mn: 2026 оны 1–6-р сард барагдсан төгрөгийн кейсүүдээс цуглуулсан дүнг хаагдсан сараар нь, оны эхнээс хуримтлагдсан дүнгийн хамт гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 1-6-r sard baragdsan tugrugiin keisvvdees tsugluulsan dvng haagdsan saraar ni, onii ehnees hurimtlagdsan dvngiin hamt garga.
question_en: For MNT cases resolved in Jan–Jun 2026, show the collected amount by closing month together with the year-to-date cumulative amount.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', closed_date)::date AS month, SUM(collected_amount) AS collected FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status = 'RESOLVED' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND closed_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, collected, SUM(collected) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS ytd_collected FROM m ORDER BY month

question_mn: Улирал бүр шинээр авсан төлөх амлалтын тоо болон тэдгээрийн биелэлтийн хувийг 2025 оноос хойш өнөөдрийг хүртэл улирлаар гарга (амласан огноогоор, хүлээгдэж буйг хасна).
question_latin: Uliral bvr shineer awsan tulukh amlaltiin too bolon tedgeeriin bieleltiin huwiig 2025 onoos hoish unuudriig hvrtel ulirlaar garga (amlasan ognoogoor, hvleegdej buig hasna).
question_en: From 2025 up to today, by quarter (by promised date), show the number of promises and their kept rate, excluding pending ones from the rate.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM promised_date)::int || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM promised_date)::int AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS promises, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'KEPT') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('KEPT', 'PARTIALLY_KEPT', 'BROKEN')), 0), 2) AS kept_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_promises WHERE promised_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Хураагдсан барьцаатай зээлүүдийн кейсүүдийн барагдуулалтын хувь бусад кейсүүдийнхээс ялгаатай юу? Хоёр бүлгээр харьцуул (төгрөгөөр).
question_latin: Huraagdsan baritsaatai zeelvvdiin keisvvdiin baragduulaltiin huwi busad keisvvdiinhees ylgaatai yu? Hoyor bvlgeer hariltsuul (tugrugoor).
question_en: Does the recovery rate of cases on loans with seized collateral differ from other cases? Compare the two groups (in MNT).
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_collaterals lc JOIN t2s.collaterals cl ON cl.collateral_id = lc.collateral_id WHERE lc.loan_id = c.loan_id AND cl.encumbrance_status = 'SEIZED') THEN 'Хураагдсан барьцаатай' ELSE 'Бусад' END AS grp, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.collected_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(c.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.outstanding_at_open * t2s.fx_to_mnt(c.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)), 0), 2) AS recovery_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases c GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Барагдуулагч бүрийн хувьд нийт кейсийн хэдэн хувь нь барагдсан, хэдэн хувь нь данснаас хасагдсаныг нэрээр нь гаргаж, барагдсан хувиар нь эрэмбэл.
question_latin: Baragduulagch buriin khuvid niit keisiin kheden khuv ni baragdsan, kheden khuv ni dansnaas khasagdsaniig nereer ni gargaj, baragdsan khuviar ni erembel.
question_en: For each collector, show the percentage of their cases that were resolved and that were written off, ordered by the resolved percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'RESOLVED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS resolved_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF') / COUNT(*), 2) AS written_off_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.assigned_to GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name ORDER BY resolved_pct DESC, e.employee_id

question_mn: Дуудлагын хэдэн хувь нь холбогдсон эсвэл амлалт авсан үр дүнтэй байсныг автомат ба ажилтны дуудлагаар тусад нь гарга.
question_latin: Duudlagiin heden huwi ni holbogdson eswel amlalt awsan vr dvntei baisniig avtomat ba ajiltnii duudlagaar tusad ni garga.
question_en: Show, separately for automated and staff calls, the percentage of calls that resulted in contact or an obtained promise.
gold_sql: SELECT action_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_result IN ('CONTACTED', 'PROMISE_OBTAINED')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS reach_pct FROM t2s.collection_actions WHERE action_code IN ('AUTO_CALL', 'MANUAL_CALL') GROUP BY action_name

question_mn: Идэвхтэй барьцаатай холбоос дахь LTV хамгийн өндөр 5 зээлийн дугаар, барьцааны төрөл, LTV-г гарга.
question_latin: Idewhtei baritsaatai holboos dahi LTV hamgiin undur 5 zeeliin dugaar, baritsaanii turul, LTV-g garga.
question_en: List the 5 loans with the highest LTV among active loan-collateral links, with loan number, collateral type and LTV.
question_mixed: Идэвхтэй барьцааны LTV top 5 зээлийг дугаар, барьцааны төрөлтэй нь гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT l.loan_number, cl.collateral_type_name, lc.ltv_ratio FROM t2s.loan_collaterals lc JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = lc.loan_id JOIN t2s.collaterals cl ON cl.collateral_id = lc.collateral_id WHERE lc.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY lc.ltv_ratio DESC, l.loan_number, cl.collateral_number LIMIT 5

question_mn: барагдуулалтын хувь нийтдээ хэд вэ? төгрөгөөр
question_latin: baragduulaltiin huwi niitdee hed we? tugrugoor
question_en: What is the overall collection recovery rate, in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(collected_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)) / NULLIF(SUM(outstanding_at_open * t2s.fx_to_mnt(currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)), 0), 2) AS recovery_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases
notes: USD cases converted at business-date rate

question_mn: ЖДҮ-ийн хүсэлтийн моделийн дундаж дефолтын магадлал хэдэн хувь вэ?
question_latin: JDU-iin hvseltiin modeliin dundaj defoltiin magadlal heden huwi we?
question_en: What is the average probability of default (in %) from the SME application scoring model?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(pd_estimate), 2) AS avg_pd_pct FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE model_code = 'APP_SCORE_SME'

question_mn: Энэ сард данс руу хэдэн удаа зээл олгосон гүйлгээ амжилттай хийгдсэн, нийт хэдэн төгрөг вэ?
question_latin: Ene sard dans ruu heden udaa zeel olgoson gvilgee amjilttai hiigdsen, niit heden tugrug we?
question_en: How many successful loan-disbursement transactions were posted to accounts this month, and what is the total in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions, SUM(amount_mnt) AS amount_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE category = 'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: 2026 онд данснаас зээлийн эргэн төлөлт рүү хэдэн амжилттай гүйлгээ хийгдэж, нийт хэдэн төгрөг шилжсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2026 ond dansnaas zeeliin ergen tulult rvv heden amjilttai gvilgee hiigdej, niit heden tugrug shiljsen be?
question_en: In 2026, how many successful loan-repayment transactions were made from accounts, and what was the total in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions, SUM(amount_mnt) AS amount_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE category = 'LOAN_REPAYMENT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Блоклосон дүнтэй идэвхтэй харилцах данс хэд байна?
question_latin: Bloklosun dvntei idewhtei hariltsah dans hed baina?
question_en: How many active current accounts have a hold amount?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM t2s.accounts WHERE account_type_code = 'CURRENT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND hold_amount > 0

question_mn: Хууль зүйн шатны зээлүүдийн хуримтлагдсан торгуулийн үлдэгдэл нийт хэд вэ (төгрөгийн зээлээр)?
question_latin: Huuli zviin shatnii zeelvvdiin hurimtlagdsan torguuliin vldegdel niit hed we (tugrugiin zeeleer)?
question_en: What is the total outstanding penalty on MNT loans in the legal stage?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(penalty_outstanding) AS penalty_outstanding FROM t2s.loans WHERE status_code = 'LEGAL' AND currency_code = 'MNT'

question_mn: PEP харилцагчид хэд байна, үүнээс хэд нь KYC баталгаажсан бэ?
question_latin: PEP hariltsagchid hed baina, vvnees hed ni KYC batalgaajsan be?
question_en: How many PEP customers are there, and how many of them are KYC-verified?
question_mixed: PEP customer хэд, KYC verified нь хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pep_customers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kyc_status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified FROM t2s.customers WHERE is_pep

question_mn: Уул уурхайн чиглэлийн байгууллага зээлдэгчдийн идэвхтэй зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл хэд вэ?
question_latin: Uul uurkhain chiglelin baiguullaga zeeldegchdiin idevkhtei zeeliin bagtsiin undsen uldegdel khed ve?
question_en: What is the active-portfolio outstanding principal of organization borrowers in the mining sector?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.organizations o ON o.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE o.industry_sector = 'Уул уурхай' AND l.is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Байгууллагын хуулийн хэлбэр бүрээр чанаргүй зээлийн хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Baiguullagiin huuliin helber bvreer chanargvi zeeliin huwiig garga.
question_en: Show the NPL ratio by organization legal form.
gold_sql: SELECT o.legal_form, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.organizations o ON o.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY o.legal_form

question_mn: Хувь хүн зээлдэгчдийн PAR30-ийг хөдөлмөр эрхлэлтийн төрлөөр нь гарга
question_latin: Khuv khun zeeldegchdiin PAR30-iig khodolmor erkhleltiin torloor ni garga
question_en: Show PAR30 for individual borrowers by employment type.
gold_sql: SELECT i.employment_type, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY i.employment_type

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээлтэй хувь хүмүүс болон хэтрээгүй хувь хүмүүсийн дундаж сарын орлогыг харьцуул.
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsad hugatsaa hetersen zeeltei huwi hvmvvs bolon hetreegvi huwi hvmvvsiin dundaj sariin orlogiig hariltsuul.
question_en: Compare the average monthly income of individuals with an overdue active-portfolio loan versus those without.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = i.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio AND l.days_past_due > 0) THEN 'Хэтэрсэн зээлтэй' ELSE 'Хэтрээгүй' END AS grp, ROUND(AVG(i.monthly_income), 2) AS avg_income FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = i.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio) GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Гэрээ байгуулсан хүсэлтүүд шийдвэр гарснаас хойш дунджаар хэдэн хоногийн дараа зээл болж олгогдсоныг хүсэлтийн сувгаар гарга.
question_latin: Geree baiguulsan hvseltvvd shiidwer garsnaas hoish dundjaar heden honogiin daraa zeel bolj olgogdsoniig hvseltiin suwgaar garga.
question_en: By application channel, show the average days from decision to disbursement for contracted applications.
gold_sql: SELECT a.channel, ROUND(AVG(l.disbursement_date - a.decided_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_disburse FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.application_id = a.application_id WHERE a.status_code = 'CONTRACTED' AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.channel

question_mn: Одоо чанаргүй ангилалтай болон бусад идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн анх хүсэлт гаргах үеийн скорингийн дундаж оноог харьцуул.
question_latin: Odoo chanargvi angilaltai bolon busad idewhtei zeelvvdiin anh hvselt gargah veiin skoringiin dundaj onoog hariltsuul.
question_en: Compare the average application credit score of currently non-performing loans versus other active-portfolio loans.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN l.is_npl THEN 'NPL' ELSE 'Бусад' END AS grp, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.credit_scores s ON s.application_id = l.application_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Скорингийн зөвлөмж тус бүрээр зээлийн хүсэлтийн зөвшөөрлийн хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Skoringiin zuwlumj tus bvreer zeeliin hvseltiin zuwshuurliin huwiig garga.
question_en: Show the loan application approval rate by scoring decision hint.
gold_sql: SELECT s.decision_hint, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'CONTRACTED', 'EXPIRED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'CONTRACTED', 'EXPIRED', 'REJECTED')), 0), 2) AS approval_rate FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.credit_scores s ON s.application_id = a.application_id GROUP BY s.decision_hint

question_mn: Салбар бүрт ажиллаж байгаа барагдуулагчийн тоо болон нэг барагдуулагчид ногдох нээлттэй кейсийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvrt ajillaj baigaa baragduulagchiin too bolon neg baragduulagchid nogdoh neelttei keisiin toog garga.
question_en: For each branch, show the number of active collectors and the number of open cases per collector.
gold_sql: WITH e AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS collectors FROM t2s.employees WHERE position_code = 'COLLECTOR' AND employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY branch_id), c AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS open_cases FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, e.collectors, ROUND(COALESCE(c.open_cases, 0)::numeric / e.collectors, 2) AS cases_per_collector FROM e JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = e.branch_id LEFT JOIN c ON c.branch_id = e.branch_id

question_mn: Тэтгэвэр авагч харилцагчдын идэвхтэй зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр зэрэгцүүлж гарга.
question_latin: Tetgewer awagch hariltsagchdiin idewhtei zeeliin vndsen vldegdel bolon idewhtei hadgalamjiin vldegdliig tugrugoor zeregtsvvlj garga.
question_en: Show, side by side in MNT, the active-portfolio loan outstanding principal and the active deposit balance of pensioner customers.
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'IND_PENSION' AND l.is_active_portfolio) AS loans_mnt, (SELECT SUM(d.current_balance_mnt) FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'IND_PENSION' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE') AS deposits_mnt

question_mn: PEP харилцагчдын идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: PEP hariltsagchdiin idevkhtei zeeliin too, undsen uldegdliig garga
question_en: Show the number of active-portfolio loans and outstanding principal of PEP customers.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE c.is_pep AND l.is_active_portfolio

question_mn: KYC хугацаа нь дууссан харилцагчдын идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн тоо, нийт үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр гарга.
question_latin: KYC khugatsaa ni duussan kharilts agchdiin idevkhtei khadgalamjiin too, niit uldegdliig togrogoor garga.
question_en: Show the number and total MNT balance of active deposits held by customers whose KYC has expired.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deposits, SUM(d.current_balance_mnt) AS balance_mnt FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE c.kyc_status = 'EXPIRED' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: AML эрсдэлийн түвшин өндөр болон маш өндөр харилцагчид идэвхтэй зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдлийн хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байна?
question_latin: AML ersdeliin tuwshin undur bolon mash undur hariltsagchid idewhtei zeeliin bagtsiin vndsen vldegdliin heden huwiig ezelj baina?
question_en: What share of active-portfolio outstanding principal belongs to customers with high or critical AML risk level?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE c.risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS high_risk_share_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Хүсэлтийн төлөв бүрээр скорингийн дундаж оноог гарга
question_latin: Hvseltiin tuluw bvreer skoringiin dundaj onoog garga
question_en: Show the average credit score by application status.
gold_sql: SELECT a.status_name, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.credit_scores s ON s.application_id = a.application_id GROUP BY a.status_name

question_mn: Зээлийн зориулалт бүрээр тухайн хүсэлтээс үүссэн идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн PAR30-ыг гарга.
question_latin: Zeeliin zoriulalt bvreer tuhain hvseltees vvssen idewhtei zeelvvdiin PAR30-iig garga.
question_en: By loan purpose, show PAR30 of the active-portfolio loans originating from those applications.
gold_sql: SELECT a.purpose_category, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.loan_applications a ON a.application_id = l.application_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY a.purpose_category

question_mn: Харилцагчийн аймаг бүрээр идэвхтэй багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл ба идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн үлдэгдлийг зэрэгцүүлж гарга.
question_latin: Hariltsagchiin aimag bvreer idewhtei bagtsiin vndsen vldegdel ba idewhtei hadgalamjiin vldegdliig zeregtsvvlj garga.
question_en: By customer province, show active-portfolio outstanding principal alongside active deposit balance.
gold_sql: WITH lo AS (SELECT c.province, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS loans_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.province), de AS (SELECT c.province, SUM(d.current_balance_mnt) AS deposits_mnt FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.province) SELECT COALESCE(lo.province, de.province) AS province, COALESCE(lo.loans_mnt, 0) AS loans_mnt, COALESCE(de.deposits_mnt, 0) AS deposits_mnt FROM lo FULL OUTER JOIN de ON de.province = lo.province

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрээр зээлийн бүртгэлээр олгосон төгрөгийн зээлийн дүн болон данс руу орсон зээл олголтын гүйлгээний дүнг тулгаж, зөрүүг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar bvreer zeeliin bvrtgeleer olgoson tugrugiin zeeliin dvn bolon dans ruu orson zeel olgoltiin gvilgeenii dvng tulgaj, zuruug garga.
question_en: For each month of 2026, reconcile MNT loans disbursed per the loan records with MNT loan-disbursement transactions credited to accounts, and show the difference.
gold_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', disbursement_date)::date AS month, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS loans_disbursed FROM t2s.loans WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND disbursement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', transaction_date)::date AS month, SUM(amount) AS tx_disbursed FROM t2s.transactions WHERE category = 'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND transaction_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(l.month, t.month) AS month, COALESCE(l.loans_disbursed, 0) AS loans_disbursed, COALESCE(t.tx_disbursed, 0) AS tx_disbursed, COALESCE(l.loans_disbursed, 0) - COALESCE(t.tx_disbursed, 0) AS difference FROM l FULL OUTER JOIN t ON t.month = l.month ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Олгогдсон зээлүүдийн хувьд скорингийн эрсдэлийн зэрэглэл бүрээр таамагласан дундаж дефолтын магадлал болон бодитоор 90-ээс дээш хоног хэтэрч байсан зээлийн хувийг зэрэгцүүл.
question_latin: Olgogdson zeelvvdiin huwid skoringiin ersdeliin zereglel bvreer taamaglasan dundaj defoltiin magadlal bolon boditoor 90-ees deesh honog heterch baisan zeeliin huwiig zeregtsvvl.
question_en: For disbursed loans, compare by scoring risk grade the average predicted PD (%) with the actual share of loans that ever exceeded 90 days past due.
gold_sql: SELECT s.risk_grade_code, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(s.pd_estimate), 2) AS predicted_pd_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.max_days_past_due > 90) / COUNT(*), 2) AS actual_90plus_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.credit_scores s ON s.application_id = l.application_id WHERE l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.risk_grade_code

question_mn: Харилцагчийн сегмент бүрээр барагдуулалтын хувийг тооцоод (ам.долларын кейсийг өнөөдрийн ханшаар), хувиар нь эрэмбэлж байрыг гарга.
question_latin: Hariltsagchiin segment bvreer baragduulaltiin huwiig tootsood (am.dollariin keisiig unuudriin hanshaar), huwiar ni erembelj bairiig garga.
question_en: Compute the collection recovery rate by customer segment (USD cases at today's rate), ranked by rate with the rank.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT c.segment_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cc.collected_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(cc.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)) / NULLIF(SUM(cc.outstanding_at_open * t2s.fx_to_mnt(cc.currency_code, CURRENT_DATE)), 0), 2) AS recovery_rate_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases cc JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name) SELECT segment_name, recovery_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC) AS rnk FROM r ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC, segment_name

question_mn: Салбаруудыг чанаргүй зээлийн хувиар эрэмбэлж, салбарын нэр, одоо ажиллаж байгаа салбарын менежерийн нэр, NPL хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Salbaruudiig chanargvi zeeliin huwiar erembelj, salbariin ner, odoo ajillaj baigaa salbariin menejeriin ner, NPL huwiig garga.
question_en: Rank branches by NPL ratio, showing branch name, current branch manager's name and NPL ratio.
gold_sql: WITH n AS (SELECT l.branch_id, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY l.branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, e.full_name AS manager_name, n.npl_ratio FROM n JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = n.branch_id JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.branch_id = n.branch_id AND e.position_code = 'BRANCH_MANAGER' AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY n.npl_ratio DESC, b.branch_id

question_mn: 2025 онд шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь зээлтэй, хэдэн хувь нь хадгаламжтай, хэдэн хувь нь хоёулаа болсныг гарга.
question_latin: 2025 ond shineer burtguulsen kharilts agchdiin kheden khuv ni zeeltei, kheden khuv ni khadgalamjtai, kheden khuv ni khoyuulaa bolsniig garga.
question_en: Of customers onboarded in 2025, what percentage have a loan, a deposit, and both?
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT c.customer_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL) AS has_loan, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS has_deposit FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_loan) / COUNT(*), 2) AS loan_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_deposit) / COUNT(*), 2) AS deposit_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_loan AND has_deposit) / COUNT(*), 2) AS both_pct FROM c

question_mn: ЖДҮ харилцагчдын идэвхтэй зээлүүдийг байгууллага батлан даагчтай болон байхгүй гэж хуваагаад, бүлэг бүрийн NPL хувийг харьцуул.
question_latin: JDU hariltsagchdiin idewhtei zeelvvdiig baiguullaga batlan daagchtai bolon baihgvi gej huwaagaad, bvleg bvriin NPL huwiig hariltsuul.
question_en: Split SME customers' active-portfolio loans into those with and without a corporate guarantor and compare the NPL ratio of each group.
question_mixed: ЖДҮ-ийн active зээлийн NPL ratio-г corporate guarantor-тай, гүй гэж харьцуул
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_guarantors g WHERE g.loan_id = l.loan_id AND g.guarantor_type = 'CORPORATE') THEN 'Байгууллага батлан даагчтай' ELSE 'Байгууллага батлан даагчгүй' END AS grp, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'ORG_SME' AND l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрт үндсэн үлдэгдлээрээ тэргүүлж буй зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүнийг үлдэгдлийн хамт гарга (идэвхтэй багц).
question_latin: Salbar bvrt vndsen vldegdlereer tergvvlj bui zeeliin bvteegdehvvniig vldegdliin hamt garga (idewhtei bagts).
question_en: For each branch, show the loan product leading in outstanding principal, with its outstanding (active portfolio).
gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT l.branch_id, l.product_id, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY l.branch_id, l.product_id), r AS (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.branch_id ORDER BY p.outstanding_mnt DESC, p.product_id) AS rn FROM p) SELECT b.branch_name, pr.product_name, r.outstanding_mnt FROM r JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = r.branch_id JOIN t2s.products pr ON pr.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.rn = 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн идэвхтэй зээлийн жигнэсэн дундаж хүү, идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн жигнэсэн дундаж хүү ба тэдгээрийн зөрүүг гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvriin idewhtei zeeliin jignesen dundaj hvv, idewhtei hadgalamjiin jignesen dundaj hvv ba tedgeeriin zuruug garga.
question_en: For each branch, show the weighted average rate of active-portfolio loans, the weighted average rate of active deposits, and the spread.
gold_sql: WITH lr AS (SELECT branch_id, SUM(interest_rate * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS loan_rate FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY branch_id), dr AS (SELECT branch_id, SUM(interest_rate * current_balance_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(current_balance_mnt), 0) AS deposit_rate FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(lr.loan_rate, 2) AS loan_rate, ROUND(dr.deposit_rate, 2) AS deposit_rate, ROUND(lr.loan_rate - dr.deposit_rate, 2) AS spread FROM lr JOIN dr ON dr.branch_id = lr.branch_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = lr.branch_id

question_mn: Идэвхтэй зээлтэй харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь 2026 оны 2-р улиралд мобайл апп эсвэл интернэт банкаар амжилттай гүйлгээ хийснийг харилцагчийн төрөл бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Idewhtei zeeltei hariltsagchdiin heden huwi ni 2026 onii 2-r ulirald mobail app eswel internet bankaar amjilttai gvilgee hiisniig hariltsagchiin turul bvreer garga.
question_en: By customer type, what percentage of customers with an active-portfolio loan made a successful mobile-app or internet-banking transaction in Q2 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.transactions t WHERE t.customer_id = c.customer_id AND t.channel_code IN ('MOBILE', 'INTERNET') AND t.status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS digital_pct FROM t2s.customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio) GROUP BY c.customer_type_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 5-р сарын дансны хуулгаар орлогын эргэлт нь 6-р сард төлөх ёстой зээлийн хуваарийн дүнгээс бага байсан цалинтай хувь хүн харилцагч хэд вэ? (төгрөгийн данс, зээлээр)
question_latin: 2026 onii 5-r sariin dansnii huulgaar orlogiin ergelt ni 6-r sard tuluh yostoi zeeliin huwaariin dvngees baga baisan tsalintai huwi hvn hariltsagch hed we? (tugrugiin dans, zeeleer)
question_en: How many salaried individual customers had May 2026 account credit turnover lower than their loan installments due in June 2026 (MNT accounts and loans)?
gold_sql: WITH inflow AS (SELECT a.customer_id, SUM(m.total_credit) AS credit_may FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly m JOIN t2s.accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id WHERE m.balance_date = DATE '2026-05-31' AND a.currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY a.customer_id), due AS (SELECT l.customer_id, SUM(s.total_due) AS due_june FROM t2s.loan_schedule s JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id WHERE l.currency_code = 'MNT' AND l.is_active_portfolio AND s.due_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY l.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM due JOIN inflow ON inflow.customer_id = due.customer_id JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = due.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'IND_SALARY' AND inflow.credit_may < due.due_june
notes: customers without May statement rows are excluded

question_mn: Зээлийн мэргэжилтэн бүрийн хариуцсан харилцагчдын идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн үлдэгдэл болон хариуцсан идэвхтэй зээлийн үлдэгдлийг гаргаж, зээлийн үлдэгдлээр тэргүүлэх 5-ыг харуул.
question_latin: Zeeliin mergejilten bvriin hariutssan hariltsagchdiin idewhtei hadgalamjiin vldegdel bolon hariutssan idewhtei zeeliin vldegdliig gargaj, zeeliin vldegdleer tergvvleh 5-iig haruul.
question_en: For each loan officer, show the active deposit balance of the customers they manage and the active loan outstanding they manage; list the top 5 by loan outstanding.
gold_sql: WITH lo AS (SELECT loan_officer_id AS employee_id, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS loans_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY loan_officer_id), de AS (SELECT c.relationship_manager_id AS employee_id, SUM(d.current_balance_mnt) AS deposits_mnt FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.relationship_manager_id) SELECT e.full_name, lo.loans_mnt, COALESCE(de.deposits_mnt, 0) AS deposits_mnt FROM lo JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = lo.employee_id LEFT JOIN de ON de.employee_id = lo.employee_id ORDER BY lo.loans_mnt DESC, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Байгууллага зээлдэгчдийг жилийн борлуулалтын орлогоор нь 1 тэрбум хүртэл, 1–5 тэрбум, 5 тэрбумаас дээш гэж бүлэглээд бүлэг бүрийн PAR30-ыг гарга.
question_latin: Baiguullaga zeeldegchdiig jiliin borluulaltiin orlogoor ni 1 terbum hvrtel, 1-5 terbum, 5 terbumaas deesh gej bvlegleed bvleg bvriin PAR30-iig garga.
question_en: Group organization borrowers by annual revenue (up to 1 bn, 1–5 bn, over 5 bn MNT) and show PAR30 for each group.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.annual_revenue < 1000000000 THEN '1 тэрбум хүртэл' WHEN o.annual_revenue < 5000000000 THEN '1-5 тэрбум' ELSE '5 тэрбумаас дээш' END AS revenue_group, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.organizations o ON o.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Эмэгтэй харилцагчдын дундаж сарын орлого хэд вэ?
question_latin: emegtei hariltsagchdiin dundaj sariin orlogo hed we?
question_en: What is the average monthly income of female customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 2) AS avg_monthly_income FROM t2s.individuals WHERE gender = 'FEMALE'

question_mn: Хариуцсан зээлийн мэргэжилтэн нь томилогдоогүй харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Hariutssan zeeliin mergejilten ni tomilogdoogvi hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many customers have no assigned relationship officer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE relationship_manager_id IS NULL

question_mn: ХК хэлбэртэй байгууллага харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: HK helbertei baiguullaga hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many organization customers are joint-stock companies?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS jsc_customers FROM t2s.organizations WHERE legal_form = 'JSC'

question_mn: Сарын орлого нь 10 сая төгрөгөөс давдаг хувь хүн харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Sariin orlogo ni 10 saya togrogoos davdag khuvi khun khariltsagch khed ve?
question_en: How many individual customers earn more than 10 million MNT a month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.individuals WHERE monthly_income > 10000000

question_mn: Хамгийн сүүлд ажилд орсон ажилтан хэн бэ? Хэзээ орсон бэ?
question_latin: Hamgiin svvld ajild orson ajiltan hen be? Hezee orson be?
question_en: Who is the most recently hired employee, and when were they hired?
gold_sql: SELECT full_name, hire_date FROM t2s.employees ORDER BY hire_date DESC, employee_id LIMIT 1

question_mn: Гадаадын (Монголоос бусад улсын) харилцагчдыг улсаар нь тоолж гарга
question_latin: gadaadiin (Mongoloos busad ulsiin) hariltsagchdiig ulsaar ni toolj garga
question_en: Count foreign customers (from countries other than Mongolia) by country.
gold_sql: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE country_code <> 'MN' GROUP BY country_code

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчийн төрөл бүрээр эрэгтэй, эмэгтэй харилцагчийн тоог тусад нь гарга
question_latin: Khuvi khun khariltsagchiin torol bureer eregtei, emegtei khariltsagchiin toog tusad ni garga
question_en: For each individual customer type, show the number of male and female customers separately.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.gender = 'MALE') AS male, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.gender = 'FEMALE') AS female FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_type_name

question_mn: Гэрлэлтийн байдал бүрээр хувь хүн харилцагчийн тоо, дундаж сарын орлого ямар байна?
question_latin: Gerleltiin baidal bvreer huwi hvn hariltsagchiin too, dundaj sariin orlogo yamar baina?
question_en: What are the number of individual customers and their average monthly income by marital status?
gold_sql: SELECT marital_status, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 2) AS avg_monthly_income FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY marital_status

question_mn: Хөдөлмөр эрхлэлтийн төрөл тус бүрийн харилцагчдын дундаж нас хэд вэ?
question_latin: Khodolmor erkhleltiin torol tus buriin khariltsagchdiin dundaj nas khed ve?
question_en: What is the average age of customers in each employment type?
gold_sql: SELECT employment_type, ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY employment_type

question_mn: Эрсдэл өндөр, маш өндөр гэж үнэлэгдсэн харилцагч аль 3 салбарт хамгийн олон байна? Салбарын нэр, тоог хэл
question_latin: Ersdel ondor, mash ondor gej unelegdsen khariltsagch ali 3 salbart khamgiin olon baina? Salbariin ner, toog khel
question_en: Which 3 branches have the most customers rated high or critical risk? Give the branch names and the counts.
question_mixed: High болон critical risk level-тэй customer хамгийн олон top 3 branch-ийн нэр, тоог гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS high_risk_customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY high_risk_customers DESC, b.branch_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр KYC баталгаажсан болон баталгаажаагүй харилцагчийн тоог тус тусад нь гарга
question_latin: Segment bvreer KYC batalgaajsan bolon batalgaajaagvi hariltsagchiin toog tus tusad ni garga
question_en: For each segment, show the number of KYC-verified and not-verified customers separately.
question_mixed: Segment бүрээр KYC verified болон verified биш customer-ийн тоог гарга
gold_sql: SELECT segment_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kyc_status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kyc_status <> 'VERIFIED') AS not_verified FROM t2s.customers GROUP BY segment_name

question_mn: Хуулийн этгээдийн хэлбэр бүрээр байгууллагуудын ажилчдын дундаж тоо, нийт жилийн борлуулалтын орлогыг гарга
question_latin: Khuuliin etgeediin khelber bureer baiguullaguudiin ajilchdiin dundaj too, niit jiliin borluulaltiin orlogiig garga
question_en: For each legal form, show the organizations' average number of employees and total annual revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT legal_form, ROUND(AVG(employee_count), 2) AS avg_employees, SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue FROM t2s.organizations GROUP BY legal_form

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдыг сарын орлогоор нь 1 саяас доош, 1–3 сая, 3–5 сая, 5 сая ба түүнээс дээш гэж бүлэглээд бүлэг бүрт хэдэн хүн байгааг гарга
