question_latin: Huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig sariin orlogoor ni 1 sayaas doosh, 1-3 saya, 3-5 saya, 5 saya ba tvvnees deesh gej bvlegleed bvleg bvrt heden hvn baigaag garga
question_en: Group individual customers by monthly income (under 1 million, 1-3 million, 3-5 million, 5 million and above) and show how many people fall into each group.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN monthly_income < 1000000 THEN '1 саяас доош' WHEN monthly_income < 3000000 THEN '1-3 сая' WHEN monthly_income < 5000000 THEN '3-5 сая' ELSE '5 сая+' END AS income_band, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Насны бүлэг (30 хүртэл, 30–44, 45–59, 60 ба түүнээс дээш) бүрээр эрэгтэй, эмэгтэй харилцагчийн тоог гарга
question_latin: nasnii buleg (30 khurtel, 30-44, 45-59, 60 ba tuunees deesh) bureer eregtei, emegtei khariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: Show the number of male and female customers in each age group (under 30, 30-44, 45-59, 60 and over).
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN age < 30 THEN '30 хүртэл' WHEN age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN age < 60 THEN '45-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'MALE') AS male, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'FEMALE') AS female FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Улаанбаатараас бусад аймгуудаас хамгийн олон харилцагчтай 5 аймаг, харилцагчийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Ulaanbaataraas busad aimguudaas hamgiin olon hariltsagchtai 5 aimag, hariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: Outside Ulaanbaatar, show the 5 provinces with the most customers and their customer counts.
gold_sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE province <> 'Улаанбаатар' GROUP BY province ORDER BY customers DESC, province LIMIT 5

question_mn: Одоо ажиллаж байгаа ажилтнууд хэлтэс бүрээрээ дунджаар хэдэн жил ажиллаж байна вэ? Хэлтэсгүй гүйцэтгэх захирлыг тооцохгүй.
question_latin: Odoo ajillaj baigaa ajiltnuud heltes bvreeree dundjaar heden jil ajillaj baina we? Heltesgvi gvitsetgeh zahirliig tootsohgvi.
question_en: On average, how many years have currently working employees been employed, by department? Exclude the CEO, who has no department.
gold_sql: SELECT department_name, ROUND(AVG((CURRENT_DATE - hire_date) / 365.25), 2) AS avg_years FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND department_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр мөнгө угаалтын шалгалтад тааралт нь шалгагдаж байгаа болон хаагдсан төлөвтэй харилцагчийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Salbar bureer mongo ugaaltiin shalgaltad taaralt ni shalgagdaj baigaa bolon khaagdsan tolovtei khariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: For each branch, show the number of customers whose AML screening is pending a match review and the number that are blocked.
question_mixed: Branch бүрээр AML status нь match pending болон blocked харилцагчийн тоог гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.aml_status = 'MATCH_PENDING') AS match_pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.aml_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Хаагдсан салбарт харьяалагдсан хэвээр байгаа харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: haagdsan salbart hariyaalagdsan heweer baigaa hariltsagch hed bn
question_en: How many customers are still assigned to a branch that has been closed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE NOT b.is_active

question_mn: Сүүлийн 90 хоногт салбар бүрт хэдэн шинэ харилцагч бүртгэгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Svvliin 90 honogt salbar bvrt heden shine hariltsagch bvrtgegdsen be?
question_en: How many new customers were registered at each branch in the last 90 days?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.onboarded_date > CURRENT_DATE - 90 GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: 2024 оноос хойш жил бүр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь одоо идэвхтэй төлөвтэй байгааг бүртгүүлсэн оноор нь гарга
question_latin: 2024 onoos hoish jil bvr bvrtgvvlsen hariltsagchdiin heden huwi ni odoo idewhtei tuluwtei baigaag bvrtgvvlsen onoor ni garga
question_en: For customers onboarded each year since 2024, show by onboarding year what percentage currently have active status.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM onboarded_date)::int AS onboard_year, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE') / COUNT(*), 2) AS active_pct FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдын сарын орлогын медианыг сегмент бүрээр гарга
question_latin: khuvi khun khariltsagchdiin sariin orlogiin medianiig segment bureer garga
question_en: Show the median monthly income of individual customers by segment.
question_mixed: Хувь хүн харилцагчдын monthly income-ийн median-ийг segment бүрээр гарга
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.monthly_income)::numeric, 2) AS median_income FROM t2s.individuals i JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name

question_mn: Байгууллага харилцагчдыг үйл ажиллагаа явуулсан хугацаагаар нь 5 хүртэл жил, 5–10 жил, 10–20 жил, 20-оос дээш жил гэж ангилаад тоолно уу
question_latin: Baiguullaga hariltsagchdiig vil ajillagaa yawuulsan hugatsaagaar ni 5 hvrtel jil, 5-10 jil, 10-20 jil, 20-oos deesh jil gej angilaad toolno uu
question_en: Classify organization customers by how long they have been operating (up to 5 years, 5-10 years, 10-20 years, over 20 years) and count them.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN establishment_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years' THEN '5 хүртэл жил' WHEN establishment_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years' THEN '5-10 жил' WHEN establishment_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 years' THEN '10-20 жил' ELSE '20-оос дээш' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS organizations FROM t2s.organizations GROUP BY 1

question_mn: 60 ба түүнээс дээш настай хэрнээ тэтгэвэр авагч гэж бүртгэгдээгүй хувь хүн харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: 60 ba tuunees deesh nastai khernee tetgever avagch gej burtgegdeegui khuvi khun khariltsagch khed bn
question_en: How many individual customers aged 60 or over are not registered as pensioners?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.age >= 60 AND c.customer_type_code <> 'IND_PENSION'

question_mn: Ажлын газар нь бүртгэлтэй хувь хүн харилцагчдын хувьд ажил олгогч байгууллага бүрээр харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй байгааг гарга
question_latin: Ajliin gazar ni bvrtgeltei huwi hvn hariltsagchdiin huwid ajil olgogch baiguullaga bvreer hariltsagchdiin heden huwi ni idewhtei bagtsad zeeltei baigaag garga
question_en: For individual customers with a recorded employer, show by employer the percentage of customers who have a loan in the active portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT i.employer_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = i.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS borrower_pct FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.employer_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.employer_name

question_mn: Хөдөлмөр эрхлэлтийн төрөл бүрт дундаж сарын орлогоороо тэргүүлдэг мэргэжил аль вэ? Төрөл, мэргэжил, дундаж орлогыг гарга
question_latin: hudulmur erhleltiin turul bvrt dundaj sariin orlogooroo tergvvldeg mergejil ali we? Turul, mergejil, dundaj orlogiig garga
question_en: Within each employment type, which occupation has the highest average monthly income? Show the employment type, occupation and average income.
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT employment_type, occupation, AVG(monthly_income) AS avg_income FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY employment_type, occupation), r AS (SELECT employment_type, occupation, avg_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY employment_type ORDER BY avg_income DESC, occupation) AS rn FROM o) SELECT employment_type, occupation, ROUND(avg_income, 2) AS avg_income FROM r WHERE rn = 1

question_mn: Хариуцсан харилцагчийн тоо нь бүх зээлийн мэргэжилтний дунджаас их байгаа ажилтнуудын нэр, харилцагчийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Khariutssan khariltsagchiin too ni bukh zeeliin mergejiltnii dundjaas ikh baigaa ajiltnuudiin ner, khariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: Show the names and customer counts of officers who manage more customers than the average across all relationship officers.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT relationship_manager_id, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE relationship_manager_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY relationship_manager_id) SELECT e.full_name, r.customers FROM r JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = r.relationship_manager_id WHERE r.customers > (SELECT AVG(customers) FROM r)

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр сарын орлого нь тухайн сегментийнхээ дунджаас өндөр хувь хүн харилцагч хэд байгааг гарга
question_latin: Segment bvreer sariin orlogo ni tuhain segmentiinhee dundjaas undur huwi hvn hariltsagch hed baigaag garga
question_en: For each segment, how many individual customers have a monthly income above their segment's average?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.segment_name, i.monthly_income, AVG(i.monthly_income) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment_name) AS segment_avg FROM t2s.individuals i JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id) SELECT segment_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE monthly_income > segment_avg) AS above_avg_customers FROM x GROUP BY segment_name

question_mn: KYC баталгаажаагүй харилцагчийн эзлэх хувь хамгийн өндөр салбараас эхлүүлэн бүх салбарыг жагсааж, салбар бүрийн хувь болон эрэмбийн дугаарыг харуул
question_latin: KYC batalgaajaagui khariltsagchiin ezlekh khuvi khamgiin ondor salbaraas ekhluulen bukh salbariig jagsaaj, salbar buriin khuvi bolon erembiin dugaariig kharuul
question_en: List all branches starting from the one with the highest share of customers whose KYC is not verified, showing each branch's percentage and rank number.
gold_sql: WITH k AS (SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.kyc_status <> 'VERIFIED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS not_verified_pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, not_verified_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY not_verified_pct DESC) AS rank_no FROM k ORDER BY rank_no

question_mn: Салбар бүрт одоо ажиллаж буй нэг зээлийн мэргэжилтэнд хэдэн харилцагч ногдож байна вэ?
question_latin: salbar bvrt odoo ajillaj bui neg zeeliin mergejiltend heden hariltsagch nogdoj bn we
question_en: For each branch, how many customers are there per currently working loan officer?
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers GROUP BY branch_id), o AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS officers FROM t2s.employees WHERE position_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER' AND employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(c.customers::numeric / o.officers, 2) AS customers_per_officer FROM c JOIN o ON o.branch_id = c.branch_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдыг насаар нь 30 хүртэл, 30–44, 45–59, 60 ба түүнээс дээш гэж ангилж, ангилал бүрийн хэдэн хувь нь идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй байгааг гарга
question_latin: Huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig nasaar ni 30 hvrtel, 30-44, 45-59, 60 ba tvvnees deesh gej angilj, angilal bvriin heden huwi ni idewhtei bagtsad zeeltei baigaag garga
question_en: Classify individual customers into age bands (under 30, 30-44, 45-59, 60 and over) and show what percentage of each band has a loan in the active portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.age < 30 THEN '30 хүртэл' WHEN i.age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN i.age < 60 THEN '45-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_band, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = i.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS borrower_pct FROM t2s.individuals i GROUP BY 1

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн эцэст хаагдаагүй, бүртгэлтэй байсан харилцагч нийт хэд байсныг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii sar buriin etsest khaagdaagui, burtgeltei baisan khariltsagch niit khed baisniig garga
question_en: Show the total number of registered, not-yet-closed customers at the end of each month of 2026.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT (generate_series(DATE '2026-01-01', DATE '2026-06-01', INTERVAL '1 month') + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date AS month_end) SELECT m.month_end, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customers FROM m JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.onboarded_date <= m.month_end AND (c.closed_date IS NULL OR c.closed_date > m.month_end) GROUP BY m.month_end ORDER BY m.month_end
notes: сарын эцсийн огноонд бүртгэгдсэн, тэр өдөр хаагдаагүй харилцагч

question_mn: Энэ онд шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчдын тоог салбар бүрээр гаргаж, салбар бүр нийт шинэ харилцагчийн хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байгааг харуул
question_latin: Ene ond shineer bvrtgvvlsen hariltsagchdiin toog salbar bvreer gargaj, salbar bvr niit shine hariltsagchiin heden huwiig ezelj baigaag haruul
question_en: Show the number of customers newly registered this year by branch, and each branch's share of all new customers.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS new_customers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.onboarded_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Байгууллага харилцагчдын үйл ажиллагааны салбар бүрээр идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй байгууллагын эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: baiguullaga khariltsagchdiin uil ajillagaanii salbar bureer idevkhtei bagtsad zeeltei baiguullagiin ezlekh khuviig garga
question_en: By industry sector, show the percentage of organization customers that have a loan in the active portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT o.industry_sector, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = o.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS borrower_pct FROM t2s.organizations o GROUP BY o.industry_sector

question_mn: Салбар бүрт хамгийн өндөр сарын орлоготой хувь хүн харилцагчийн дугаар болон орлогыг гарга
question_latin: Salbar bvrt hamgiin undur sariin orlogotoi huwi hvn hariltsagchiin dugaar bolon orlogiig garga
question_en: For each branch, show the customer number and income of the individual customer with the highest monthly income.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT b.branch_name, c.customer_number, i.monthly_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.branch_id ORDER BY i.monthly_income DESC, c.customer_id) AS rn FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id) SELECT branch_name, customer_number, monthly_income FROM r WHERE rn = 1

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрт шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчийн тоо болон өмнөх улирлаас хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvrt shineer bvrtgvvlsen hariltsagchiin too bolon umnuh ulirlaas heden huwiar uurchlugdsuniig garga
question_en: Show the number of new customers in each quarter of 2025 and the percentage change from the previous quarter.
question_mixed: 2025 оны quarter бүрийн new customer тоо болон QoQ өөрчлөлтийн %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', onboarded_date)::date AS quarter_start, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT quarter_start, new_customers, ROUND(100.0 * (new_customers - LAG(new_customers) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(new_customers) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 0), 2) AS qoq_change_pct FROM q) SELECT quarter_start, new_customers, qoq_change_pct FROM c WHERE quarter_start >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY quarter_start

question_mn: Идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагчдыг идэвхтэй зээл, идэвхтэй хадгаламж, идэвхтэй харилцах данс гэсэн гурван бүтээгдэхүүнээс хэдийг нь эзэмшдэгээр нь (0–3) бүлэглэж тоолно уу
question_latin: Idevkhtei tolovtei khariltsagchdiig idevkhtei zeel, idevkhtei khadgalamj, idevkhtei khariltsakh dans gesen gurvan buteegdekhuunees khediig ni ezemshdegeer ni (0-3) buleglej toolno uu
question_en: Group active customers by how many of three products they hold (an active-portfolio loan, an active deposit, an active current account), from 0 to 3, and count them.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT c.customer_id, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio))::int + (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE'))::int + (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id AND a.account_type_code = 'CURRENT' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'))::int AS products_held FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE') SELECT products_held, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM h GROUP BY products_held ORDER BY products_held

question_mn: Блоклогдсон хадгаламж хэд байна?
question_latin: Bloklogdson khadgalamj khed baina?
question_en: How many deposits are blocked?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS blocked_deposits FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'BLOCKED'

question_mn: Идэвхтэй төгрөгийн хугацаатай хадгаламжуудад мөрдөж буй хамгийн өндөр хүү хэдэн хувь вэ?
question_latin: idewhtei tugrugiin hugatsaatai hadgalamjuudad murduj bui hamgiin undur hvv heden huwi we?
question_en: What is the highest interest rate among active MNT term deposits?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(interest_rate) AS max_rate FROM t2s.deposits WHERE deposit_type = 'TERM' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: Нийлмэл хүүтэй идэвхтэй хадгаламж хэд вэ?
question_latin: Niilmel khuutei idevkhtei khadgalamj khed ve?
question_en: How many active deposits earn compound interest?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deposits FROM t2s.deposits WHERE interest_method = 'COMPOUND' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: 2026 оны 3-р сарын 31-ний еврогийн албан ханш хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 3-r sariin 31-nii ewrogiin alban hansh hed baisan be
question_en: What was the official euro exchange rate on 31 March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT mid_rate FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'EUR' AND rate_date = '2026-03-31'

question_mn: Энэ сард АТМ-ээс хэдэн удаа амжилттай бэлэн мөнгө авсан бэ?
question_latin: Ene sard ATM-ees heden udaa amjilttai belen mungu awsan be?
question_en: How many successful ATM cash withdrawals were made this month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS atm_withdrawals FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL' AND channel_code = 'ATM' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Сүүлийн 30 хоногт хэдэн хадгаламж шинээр нээгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Suuliin 30 khonogt kheden khadgalamj shineer neegdsen be?
question_en: How many new deposits were opened in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_deposits FROM t2s.deposits WHERE opened_date > CURRENT_DATE - 30

question_mn: Өнөөдрийн ам.долларын авах, зарах ханш хэд вэ?
question_latin: Unuudriin am.dollariin awah, zarah hansh hed we?
question_en: What are today's US dollar buying and selling rates?
question_mixed: Өнөөдрийн USD-ийн buy rate, sell rate хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT buy_rate, sell_rate FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND rate_date = CURRENT_DATE

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хугацаатай хадгаламжуудыг хугацаагаар (сараар) нь бүлэглээд, бүлэг бүрийн тоо болон үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: idewhtei hugatsaatai hadgalamjuudiig hugatsaagaar (saraar) ni bvlegleed, bvleg bvriin too bolon vldegdliig tugruguur garga
question_en: Group active term deposits by term in months and show the count and the balance in MNT for each group.
gold_sql: SELECT term_months, COUNT(*) AS deposits, SUM(current_balance_mnt) AS balance_mnt FROM t2s.deposits WHERE deposit_type = 'TERM' AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY term_months

question_mn: Хадгаламжийн төрөл бүрээр нэг идэвхтэй хадгаламжид ногдох дундаж үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Khadgalamjiin torol bureer neg idevkhtei khadgalamjid nogdokh dundaj uldegdliig togrogoor garga
question_en: Show the average balance per active deposit, in MNT, for each deposit type.
gold_sql: SELECT deposit_type, ROUND(AVG(current_balance_mnt), 2) AS avg_balance_mnt FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY deposit_type

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүн бүрээр хадгаламжуудын хэдэн хувь нь нийлмэл хүүтэй вэ?
question_latin: Bvteegdehvvn bvreer hadgalamjuudiin heden huwi ni niilmel hvvtei we
question_en: For each product, what percentage of deposits use compound interest?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.interest_method = 'COMPOUND') / COUNT(*), 2) AS compound_pct FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = d.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн амжилттай гүйлгээний орлого болон зарлагын нийт дүнг төгрөгөөр тус тусад нь гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii sar buriin amjilttai guilgeenii orlogo bolon zarlagiin niit dung togrogoor tus tusad ni garga
question_en: For each month of 2026, show the total credit (incoming) and debit (outgoing) amounts of completed transactions in MNT separately.
question_mixed: 2026 оны month бүрийн completed гүйлгээний credit болон debit дүнг MNT-ээр гарга
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', transaction_date)::date AS month, SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'C') AS credit_mnt, SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'D') AS debit_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр хэдэн амжилттай гүйлгээ хийгдэж, нэг гүйлгээний дундаж дүн төгрөгөөр хэд байв?
question_latin: ene ond sar bvr heden amjilttai gvilgee hiigdej, neg gvilgeenii dundaj dvn tugruguur hed baiw?
question_en: This year, how many successful transactions were made each month, and what was the average amount per transaction in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', transaction_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS transactions, ROUND(AVG(amount_mnt), 2) AS avg_amount_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд салбар бүрт хэдэн харилцах данс шинээр нээгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond salbar bvrt heden hariltsah dans shineer neegdsen be?
question_en: How many new current accounts were opened at each branch this year?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS opened_accounts FROM t2s.accounts a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.account_type_code = 'CURRENT' AND a.opened_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: ажлын өдрөөс хойших огноотой (ирээдүйн) 3 данс энэ шүүлтээр орохгүй

question_mn: Валют бүрээр хадгаламж эзэмшигчдэд нийт хэдэн хүү олгож, хэдэн татвар суутгасныг гарга
question_latin: Valyut bureer khadgalamj ezemshigchded niit kheden khuu olgoj, kheden tatvar suutgasniig garga
question_en: By currency, show the total interest paid out to depositors and the total tax withheld.
gold_sql: SELECT currency_code, SUM(paid_interest) AS paid_interest, SUM(withholding_tax_paid) AS withholding_tax FROM t2s.deposits GROUP BY currency_code

question_mn: Энэ онд валют бүрийн зарах, авах ханшийн зөрүү дунджаар хэдэн төгрөг байв?
question_latin: Ene ond walyut bvriin zarah, awah hanshiin zurvv dundjaar heden tugrug baiw?
question_en: This year, what was the average difference between the selling and buying rates for each currency, in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT currency_code, ROUND(AVG(sell_rate - buy_rate), 2) AS avg_spread FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE rate_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY currency_code

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сарын дансны хуулгаар дансны төрөл бүрт нэг дансанд дунджаар хэдэн гүйлгээ хийгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sariin dansnii khuulgaar dansnii torol burt neg dansand dundjaar kheden guilgee khiigdsen be?
question_en: According to the June 2026 monthly statements, how many transactions on average were made per account for each account type?
gold_sql: SELECT a.account_type_name, ROUND(AVG(m.transaction_count), 2) AS avg_transactions FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly m JOIN t2s.accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id WHERE m.balance_date = '2026-06-30' GROUP BY a.account_type_name

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр хэдэн хадгаламжийг хугацаанаас нь өмнө татаж хаасан бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond sar bvr heden hadgalamjiig hugatsaanaas ni umnu tataj haasan be?
question_en: This year, how many deposits were closed early (before maturity) each month?
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', closed_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS early_closed FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'EARLY_CLOSED' AND closed_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Төгрөгийн идэвхтэй хугацаатай хадгаламжуудад хугацаа бүрээр ямар хүү мөрдөгдөж байна вэ? Хугацаа, хүү, хадгаламжийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Tugrugiin idewhtei hugatsaatai hadgalamjuudad hugatsaa bvreer yamar hvv murdugduj baina we? Hugatsaa, hvv, hadgalamjiin toog garga
question_en: What interest rates apply to active MNT term deposits for each term? Show the term, the rate and the number of deposits.
gold_sql: SELECT term_months, interest_rate, COUNT(*) AS deposits FROM t2s.deposits WHERE deposit_type = 'TERM' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY term_months, interest_rate

question_mn: Энэ онд хийгдсэн амжилттай бэлэн мөнгө авалтын нэг гүйлгээний медиан дүнг суваг бүрээр төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Ene ond khiigdsen amjilttai belen mongo avaltiin neg guilgeenii median dung suvag bureer togrogoor garga
question_en: Show the median amount per successful cash withdrawal this year, in MNT, by channel.
question_mixed: Энэ онд completed cash withdrawal-ийн median дүнг channel бүрээр MNT-ээр гарга
gold_sql: SELECT channel_name, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount_mnt)::numeric, 2) AS median_amount_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_name
notes: дундаж нь цөөн маш том гүйлгээнд хазайдаг тул медиан

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжуудын хугацаа дуусахад дунджаар хэдэн хоног үлдсэнийг бүтээгдэхүүн бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Idewhtei hadgalamjuudiin hugatsaa duusahad dundjaar heden honog vldseniig bvteegdehvvn bvreer garga
question_en: For each product, show the average number of days remaining until maturity of active deposits.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(d.maturity_date - CURRENT_DATE), 2) AS avg_days_to_maturity FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = d.product_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.maturity_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: Энэ оны сар бүрийн хуулгаар төгрөгийн бүх дансны сарын эхний үлдэгдэл, сарын нийт орлого, нийт зарлага, сарын эцсийн үлдэгдлийн нийлбэрийг гарга
question_latin: Ene onii sar bvriin huulgaar tugrugiin bvh dansnii sariin ehnii vldegdel, sariin niit orlogo, niit zarlaga, sariin etssiin vldegdliin niilberiig garga
question_en: From this year's monthly statements, show for all MNT accounts the total opening balance, total credits, total debits and total closing balance for each month.
gold_sql: SELECT balance_date, SUM(opening_balance) AS opening_balance, SUM(total_credit) AS total_credit, SUM(total_debit) AS total_debit, SUM(closing_balance) AS closing_balance FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND balance_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY balance_date ORDER BY balance_date
notes: эхний үлдэгдэл + орлого − зарлага = эцсийн үлдэгдэл

question_mn: Хадгаламжийн төрөл бүрээр идэвхтэй хадгаламжуудын хэдэн хувь нь анх байршуулсан дүнгээсээ өссөн байна вэ?
question_latin: khadgalamjiin torol bureer idevkhtei khadgalamjuudiin kheden khuvi ni ankh bairshuulsan dungeesee osson baina ve
question_en: For each deposit type, what percentage of active deposits have a current balance above the initially placed amount?
gold_sql: SELECT deposit_type, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_balance > principal_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS grown_pct FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY deposit_type

question_mn: Энэ сард амжилтгүй болсон гүйлгээнүүдийг төрлөөр нь тоолж гарга
question_latin: Ene sard amjiltgvi bolson gvilgeenvvdiig turluur ni toolj garga
question_en: Count this month's failed transactions by transaction type.
gold_sql: SELECT transaction_type_name, COUNT(*) AS failed_transactions FROM t2s.transactions WHERE status_code = 'FAILED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY transaction_type_name

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр шинээр нээгдсэн төгрөгийн хугацаатай хадгаламжуудын анхны дүнгээр жигнэсэн дундаж хүүг гарга
question_latin: Ene ond sar bur shineer neegdsen togrogiin khugatsaatai khadgalamjuudiin ankhnii dungeer jignesen dundaj khuug garga
question_en: For MNT term deposits opened in each month of this year, show the average interest rate weighted by the initial amount.
question_mixed: Энэ онд month бүр нээгдсэн төгрөгийн term deposit-уудын principal-аар жигнэсэн weighted average rate-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', opened_date)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(interest_rate * principal_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_amount), 0), 2) AS weighted_rate FROM t2s.deposits WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND deposit_type = 'TERM' AND opened_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр харилцагчдын дансанд орж ирсэн мөнгө гарсан мөнгөнөөсөө хэдээр их эсвэл бага байсныг (амжилттай гүйлгээ, төгрөгөөр), мөн 1-р сараас хойш нийлбэрээрээ хэд болсныг гарга
question_latin: ene ond sar bvr hariltsagchdiin dansand orj irsen mungu garsan mungunuusuu hedeer ih eswel baga baisniig (amjilttai gvilgee, tugruguur), mun 1-r saraas hoish niilbereeree hed bolsniig garga
question_en: For each month this year, show by how much the money flowing into customers' accounts exceeded or fell short of the money flowing out (completed transactions, in MNT), and the running total since January.
question_mixed: Энэ онд month бүрийн net flow (credit − debit, MNT) болон January-аас хойшх running total-ыг гарга
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', transaction_date)::date AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'C' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS net_flow FROM t2s.transactions WHERE status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, net_flow, SUM(net_flow) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_net_flow FROM m ORDER BY month

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрт хамгийн олон хадгаламж шинээр нээсэн 3 салбар, нээсэн хадгаламжийн тоог гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvrt hamgiin olon hadgalamj shineer neesen 3 salbar, neesen hadgalamjiin toog garga
question_en: For each quarter of 2025, show the 3 branches that opened the most new deposits and the number of deposits opened.
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d.opened_date)::int AS quarter, b.branch_id, b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS new_deposits FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = d.branch_id WHERE d.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, b.branch_id, b.branch_name), r AS (SELECT quarter, branch_name, new_deposits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY new_deposits DESC, branch_id) AS rn FROM q) SELECT quarter, branch_name, new_deposits FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY quarter, rn

question_mn: Энэ сарын ажлын өдөр бүр ам.долларын албан ханш өмнөх ажлын өдрөөсөө хэдэн төгрөгөөр өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: Ene sariin ajliin odor bur am.dollariin alban khansh omnokh ajliin odroosoo kheden togrogoor oorchlogdsoniig garga
question_en: For each business day this month, show how many MNT the official US dollar rate changed from the previous business day.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rate_date, mid_rate, mid_rate - LAG(mid_rate) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date) AS change_mnt FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND rate_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-06-30') SELECT rate_date, mid_rate, ROUND(change_mnt, 2) AS change_mnt FROM r WHERE rate_date >= '2026-06-01' ORDER BY rate_date
notes: сарын эхний ажлын өдрийн өөрчлөлтийг 5-р сарын сүүлийн ажлын өдөртэй харьцуулна (6-р сарын 1 амралтын өдөр)

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн нийт үлдэгдэл нь 100 сая төгрөгөөс давсан харилцагчдыг сегментээр нь тоолж гарга
question_latin: idewhtei hadgalamjiin niit vldegdel ni 100 saya tugruguus dawsan hariltsagchdiig segmenteer ni toolj garga
question_en: Count, by segment, the customers whose total active deposit balance exceeds 100 million MNT.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(current_balance_mnt) > 100000000) SELECT c.segment_name, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM s JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name

question_mn: Энэ оны эхний 6 сарын гүйлгээний тоог өнгөрсөн оны мөн сартай нь харьцуулж, өсөлтийн хувийг сар бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Ene onii ehnii 6 sariin gvilgeenii toog ungursun onii mun sartai ni haritsuulj, usultiin huwiig sar bvreer garga
question_en: Compare the number of transactions in each of the first 6 months of this year with the same month last year and show the growth percentage.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date)::int AS month_no, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS tx_2025, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS tx_2026 FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' OR transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month_no, tx_2025, tx_2026, ROUND(100.0 * (tx_2026 - tx_2025) / NULLIF(tx_2025, 0), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month_no

question_mn: 2024 оноос хойш нээгдсэн харилцах дансны хувьд данс нээснээс анхны гүйлгээ хийх хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног болдог вэ?
question_latin: 2024 onoos khoish neegdsen khariltsakh dansnii khuvid dans neesnees ankhnii guilgee khiikh khurtel dundjaar kheden khonog boldog ve?
question_en: For current accounts opened since 2024, how many days on average pass between opening the account and its first transaction?
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT account_id, MIN(transaction_date) AS first_tx_date FROM t2s.transactions GROUP BY account_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.first_tx_date - a.opened_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_first_tx FROM t2s.accounts a JOIN f ON f.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_type_code = 'CURRENT' AND a.opened_date >= '2024-01-01'

question_mn: Энэ оны 1-6-р сар бүрийн эцсийн үлдэгдэл нь өмнөх сарын эцсийнхээсээ тасралтгүй өссөн данс хэд байна?
question_latin: Ene onii 1-6-r sar bvriin etssiin vldegdel ni umnuh sariin etssiinheesee tasraltgvi ussun dans hed baina?
question_en: How many accounts had a month-end balance higher than the previous month-end in every month from January to June this year?
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT account_id, balance_date, closing_balance, LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY balance_date) AS prev_balance FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly WHERE balance_date BETWEEN '2025-12-31' AND '2026-06-30') SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM (SELECT account_id FROM m WHERE balance_date >= '2026-01-31' GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 6 AND bool_and(COALESCE(closing_balance > prev_balance, false))) t
notes: 1-р сарыг 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцэстэй харьцуулна; өмнөх сарын хуулгагүй бол өсөлт гэж тооцохгүй

question_mn: 2025 оны эцэст үлдэгдэлтэй байсан ч 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцэст үлдэгдэлгүй болсон эсвэл сарын хуулгад огт гараагүй данс хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2025 onii etsest vldegdeltei baisan ch 2026 onii 6-r sariin etsest vldegdelgvi bolson eswel sariin huulgad ogt garaagvi dans hed we?
question_en: How many accounts had a positive balance at the end of 2025 but had a zero balance, or no statement at all, at the end of June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly a LEFT JOIN t2s.account_balances_monthly b ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND b.balance_date = '2026-06-30' WHERE a.balance_date = '2025-12-31' AND a.closing_balance > 0 AND COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0) = 0
notes: сарын хуулгыг өөртэй нь LEFT JOIN хийнэ

question_mn: Энэ улиралд амжилттай гүйлгээний нийт дүнгээрээ (орлого, зарлага хамт, төгрөгөөр) тэргүүлсэн 5 харилцагчийн дугаар, дүн, нийт гүйлгээний дүнд эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: Ene ulirald amjilttai gvilgeenii niit dvngeeree (orlogo, zarlaga hamt, tugruguur) tergvvlsen 5 hariltsagchiin dugaar, dvn, niit gvilgeenii dvnd ezleh huwiig garga
question_en: Show the top 5 customers by total completed transaction amount this quarter (credits and debits together, in MNT), with their customer numbers, amounts and share of the total.
question_mixed: Энэ quarter-т completed гүйлгээний turnover-оор top 5 customer-ийн дугаар, дүн, share %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount_mnt) AS turnover_mnt FROM t2s.transactions WHERE status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY customer_id), r AS (SELECT customer_id, turnover_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * turnover_mnt / SUM(turnover_mnt) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM s) SELECT c.customer_number, r.turnover_mnt, r.share_pct FROM r JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id ORDER BY r.turnover_mnt DESC, r.customer_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Энэ онд татварын өрийн дансанд нийт хэдэн төгрөг кредитлэгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond tatwariin uriin dansand niit heden tugrug kreditlegdsen be?
question_en: How much has been credited to the tax payable account this year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS tax_credited FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '2300' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND fiscal_year = 2026

question_mn: Ерөнхий дэвтэрт ам.доллараар бүртгэгдсэн мөр нийт хэд байна?
question_latin: Yerunhii devtert am.dollaraar burtgegdsen mur niit khed baina?
question_en: How many general ledger lines are recorded in US dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS usd_lines FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE currency_code = 'USD'

question_mn: 2025 онд залруулгын журналаар хэдэн бичилт хийгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond zalruulgiin jurnalaar heden bichilt hiigdsen be?
question_en: How many journal entries were posted in the adjustment journal in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entry_no) AS entries FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE journal_code = 'ADJ_J' AND fiscal_year = 2025

question_mn: Өнгөрсөн сарын эцсийн агшинд эргэлзээтэй эсвэл муу ангилалтай хэдэн зээл байсан бэ?
question_latin: Ungursun sariin etssiin agshind ergelzeetei eswel muu angilaltai heden zeel baisan be?
question_en: How many loans were classified as doubtful or loss at last month's month-end snapshot?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS npl_loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date = DATE '2026-05-31' AND classification_code IN ('DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS')

question_mn: 2025 оны ам.долларын хамгийн бага, хамгийн их албан ханш хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 onii am.dollariin khamgiin baga, khamgiin ikh alban khansh khed baisan be?
question_en: What were the lowest and highest official USD rates in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(mid_rate) AS min_rate, MAX(mid_rate) AS max_rate FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND rate_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

question_mn: шимтгэлийн орлого өнгөрсөн сард хэд?
question_latin: shimtgeliin orlogo ungursun sard hed?
question_en: Fee income last month?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS fee_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4200' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31'

question_mn: Энэ оны үйл ажиллагааны зардлыг сар сараар гаргаж өг
question_latin: Ene onii uil ajillagaanii zardliig sar saraar gargaj og
question_en: Give this year's operating expense month by month.
gold_sql: SELECT period_code, SUM(amount_mnt) AS operating_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5400' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND fiscal_year = 2026 GROUP BY period_code ORDER BY period_code

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрийн шимтгэлийн болон торгуулийн орлогыг хоёр тусдаа баганаар гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvriin shimtgeliin bolon torguuliin orlogiig hoyor tusdaa baganaar garga.
question_en: Show fee income and penalty income for each quarter of 2025 as two separate columns.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM posting_date)::int AS quarter, SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE account_code = '4200' AND dr_cr = 'C') AS fee_income, SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE account_code = '4300' AND dr_cr = 'C') AS penalty_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Сүүлийн 3 бүтэн сарын (4–6-р сар) хадгаламжийн хүүгийн зардлыг сар бүрээр харуул
question_latin: Suuliin 3 buten sariin (4-6-r sar) khadgalamjiin khuugiin zardliig sar buriig kharuul
question_en: Show deposit interest expense for each of the last 3 full months (April–June).
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', posting_date)::date AS month, SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний хагаст эрсдэлийн сангийн цэвэр зардал хамгийн их гарсан 3 салбарыг дүнтэй нь жагсаа.
question_latin: 2026 onii ehnii hagast ersdeliin sangiin tsewer zardal hamgiin ih garsan 3 salbariig dvntei ni jagsaa.
question_en: List the 3 branches with the highest net provision expense in H1 2026, with amounts.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(CASE WHEN g.dr_cr = 'D' THEN g.amount_mnt ELSE -g.amount_mnt END) AS provision_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '5200' AND g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY provision_expense DESC, b.branch_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: Энэ онд ерөнхий дэвтрийн мөрүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь эх систем тус бүрээс ирснийг гарга.
question_latin: Ene ond yerunhii devtriin moruudiin kheden khuv ni ekh sistem tus buriig irsniig garga.
question_en: What percentage of this year's general ledger lines came from each source system?
gold_sql: SELECT source_system, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE fiscal_year = 2026 GROUP BY source_system

question_mn: Журнал бүрт нэг бичилт дунджаар хэдэн мөртэй байдгийг журналын нэрээр гарга.
question_latin: Jurnal bvrt neg bichilt dundjaar heden murtei baidgiig jurnaliin nereer garga.
question_en: By journal name, show the average number of lines per journal entry.
gold_sql: SELECT journal_name, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT entry_no), 2) AS lines_per_entry FROM t2s.gl_entries GROUP BY journal_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 2-р улирлын сарын эцсийн агшин бүрт ангилал тус бүрээр хэдэн зээл байсныг тоолж гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 2-r ulirliin sariin etssiin agshin buriig angilal tus buriig kheden zeel baisniig toolj garga.
question_en: Count loans by classification at each month-end snapshot of Q2 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT snapshot_date, classification_code, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY snapshot_date, classification_code ORDER BY snapshot_date, classification_code

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрийн эцэст төгрөгийн хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээл дунджаар хэдэн төгрөгийн хугацаа хэтэрсэн үндсэн төлбөртэй байсныг гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvriin etsest tugrugiin hugatsaa hetersen zeel dundjaar heden tugrugiin hugatsaa hetersen vndsen tulburtei baisniig garga.
question_en: At each quarter-end of 2025, what was the average overdue principal per overdue MNT loan?
gold_sql: SELECT h.snapshot_date, ROUND(AVG(h.overdue_principal), 2) AS avg_overdue_principal FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE l.currency_code = 'MNT' AND h.days_past_due > 0 AND h.snapshot_date IN (DATE '2025-03-31', DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-09-30', DATE '2025-12-31') GROUP BY h.snapshot_date ORDER BY h.snapshot_date

question_mn: AML сэрэмжлүүлгийг дүрэм тус бүрээр 2025 он болон 2026 оны эхний хагаст хэд илэрснийг зэрэгцүүлж гарга
question_latin: AML seremjlvvlgiig dvrem tus bvreer 2025 on bolon 2026 onii ehnii hagast hed ilersniig zeregtsvvlj garga
question_en: By rule, show side by side how many AML alerts were detected in 2025 and in H1 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT rule_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS alerts_2025, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') AS alerts_h1_2026 FROM t2s.aml_alerts GROUP BY rule_name

question_mn: Жил бүрийн ам.долларын албан ханшийн хамгийн бага, хамгийн их утга болон хэлбэлзлийн зөрүүг гарга.
question_latin: Jil bvriin am.dollariin alban hanshiin hamgiin baga, hamgiin ih utga bolon helbelzliin zuruug garga.
question_en: For each year, show the lowest and highest official USD rate and the range between them.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rate_date)::int AS year, MIN(mid_rate) AS min_rate, MAX(mid_rate) AS max_rate, MAX(mid_rate) - MIN(mid_rate) AS rate_range FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ улирлын үйл ажиллагааны зардал өмнөх улирлынхаас хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөн бэ?
question_latin: Ene ulirliin uil ajillagaanii zardal omnokh ulirliinkhaas kheden khuviar oorchlogdson be?
question_en: By what percentage did this quarter's operating expense change compared with the previous quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') - SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'), 0), 2) AS qoq_change_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5400' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Цэвэр хүүгийн орлогыг салбар бүрээр 2026 оны эхний хагасаар гарга
question_latin: Tsewer hvvgiin orlogiig salbar bvreer 2026 onii ehnii hagasaar garga
question_en: Show net interest income by branch for H1 2026.
question_mixed: 2026 H1-ийн NII-г салбараар гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(CASE WHEN g.account_code = '4100' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' THEN g.amount_mnt WHEN g.account_code = '5100' AND g.dr_cr = 'D' THEN -g.amount_mnt ELSE 0 END) AS net_interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: 2026 оны сарын эцэс бүрт агшинд бүртгэгдсэн зээлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь хугацаа хэтэрсэн байсныг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sariin ets bvrt agshind bvrtgegdsen zeelvvdiin heden huwi ni hugatsaa hetersen baisniig garga.
question_en: For each 2026 month-end, what percentage of loans in the snapshot were overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT snapshot_date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS overdue_pct FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date

question_mn: Ерөнхий дэвтрийн чанаргүй зээлийн дансны үлдэгдлийг (дебит − кредит) 2025 оны улирал бүрийн эцсийн байдлаар хуримтлуулан гарга.
question_latin: Yerunhii dewtriin chanargvi zeeliin dansnii vldegdliig (debit - kredit) 2025 onii uliral bvriin etssiin baidlaar hurimtluulan garga.
question_en: Show the cumulative balance (debit − credit) of the GL non-performing loan account as of the end of each quarter of 2025.
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', posting_date)::date AS quarter_start, SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS net FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '1230' AND posting_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT quarter_start, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start) AS balance FROM q) SELECT (quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 month - 1 day')::date AS quarter_end, balance FROM c WHERE quarter_start >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY quarter_start

question_mn: 2026 оны сарын эцсийн агшин бүрийн зээлийн тоо болон өмнөх сарын эцсээс хэдэн хувиар өссөнийг гарга. 1-р сарыг 2025 оны 12-р сартай харьцуул.
question_latin: 2026 onii sariin etssiin agshin bvriin zeeliin too bolon umnuh sariin etsees heden huwiar ussuniig garga. 1-r sariig 2025 onii 12-r sartai hariltsuul.
question_en: For each 2026 month-end snapshot, show the number of loans and the percentage growth from the previous month-end (January vs December 2025).
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY snapshot_date), w AS (SELECT snapshot_date, loans, ROUND(100.0 * (loans - LAG(loans) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date)) / NULLIF(LAG(loans) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM m) SELECT snapshot_date, loans, growth_pct FROM w WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' ORDER BY snapshot_date

question_mn: 2026 оны 4, 5, 6-р сарын эцэст хугацаа хэтэрсэн хоног нь сар бүр тасралтгүй өссөн зээл хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 4, 5, 6-r sariin etsest hugatsaa hetersen honog ni sar bvr tasraltgvi ussun zeel hed we?
question_en: How many loans had days past due increase at each successive month-end of April, May and June 2026?
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT loan_id, snapshot_date, days_past_due, LAG(days_past_due) OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY snapshot_date) AS prev_dpd FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date IN (DATE '2026-04-30', DATE '2026-05-31', DATE '2026-06-30')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM (SELECT loan_id FROM h WHERE prev_dpd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loan_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 AND bool_and(days_past_due > prev_dpd)) t

question_mn: 2026 оны сарын эцэс бүрт хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээлүүдийн хэтэрсэн хоногийн дундаж ба медианыг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sariin ets buriig khugatsaa kheterssen zeeluudiin kheterssen khonogiin dundaj ba mediaanig garga.
question_en: For each 2026 month-end, show the mean and median days past due of overdue loans.
gold_sql: SELECT snapshot_date, ROUND(AVG(days_past_due), 2) AS avg_dpd, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_past_due) AS median_dpd FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND days_past_due > 0 GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date

question_mn: 2025 оны ам.долларын дундаж албан ханшийг улирал бүрээр гаргаад, өмнөх улирлаас хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг харуул.
question_latin: 2025 onii am.dollariin dundaj alban hanshiig uliral bvreer gargaad, umnuh ulirlaas heden huwiar uurchlugdsuniig haruul.
question_en: Show the average official USD rate for each quarter of 2025 and its percentage change from the previous quarter.
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM rate_date)::int AS quarter, AVG(mid_rate) AS avg_rate FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND rate_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1) SELECT quarter, ROUND(avg_rate, 2) AS avg_rate, ROUND(100.0 * (avg_rate - LAG(avg_rate) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) / LAG(avg_rate) OVER (ORDER BY quarter), 2) AS qoq_pct FROM q ORDER BY quarter

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн сүүлийн ажлын өдрийн юанийн албан ханшийг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar bvriin svvliin ajliin udriin yuaniin alban hanshiig garga.
question_en: Show the official CNY rate on the last business day of each month in 2026.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rate_date, mid_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', rate_date) ORDER BY rate_date DESC) AS rn FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'CNY' AND rate_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') SELECT rate_date, mid_rate FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY rate_date

question_mn: 2025 оны цэвэр хүүгийн орлогоор хамгийн өндөр 3 сарыг тайлант үе, дүн, байрын хамт гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii tsewer hvvgiin orlogoor hamgiin undur 3 sariig tailant ve, dvn, bairiin hamt garga.
question_en: List the top 3 months of 2025 by net interest income, with period, amount and rank.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT period_code, SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' THEN amount_mnt WHEN account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' THEN -amount_mnt ELSE 0 END) AS nii FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY period_code) SELECT period_code, nii, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY nii DESC) AS rnk FROM m ORDER BY nii DESC, period_code LIMIT 3

question_mn: Торгуулийн орлого 2025 оны эхний хагасаас 2026 оны эхний хагаст хамгийн их өссөн 5 салбарыг өсөлтийн дүнтэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Torguuliin orlogo 2025 onii ekhnii khagasaas 2026 onii ekhnii khagast khamgiin ikh osson 5 salbariig osoltiin duntei ni garga.
question_en: List the 5 branches whose penalty income grew the most from H1 2025 to H1 2026, with the increase.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COALESCE(SUM(g.amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(g.amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'), 0) AS increase FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '4300' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY increase DESC, b.branch_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Эрсдэлийн сангийн цэвэр зардлыг жил бүрээр гаргаж, өмнөх оноос хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг харуул.
question_latin: Ersdeliin sangiin tsever zardliig jil buriig gargaj, omnokh onoos kheden khuviar oorchlogdsoniig kharuul.
question_en: Show the net provision expense for each year and the percentage change from the previous year.
gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS provision_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5200' GROUP BY fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_year, provision_expense, ROUND(100.0 * (provision_expense - LAG(provision_expense) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year)) / NULLIF(LAG(provision_expense) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year), 0), 2) AS yoy_pct FROM y ORDER BY fiscal_year

question_mn: Хугацаатай хадгаламжийн дансны үлдэгдлийг (кредит − дебит) жил бүрийн эцсийн байдлаар хуримтлуулж гарга.
question_latin: Khugatsaatai khadgalamjiin dansnii uldegdliig (kredit - debit) jil buriin etssiin baidlaar khurimtluulj garga.
question_en: Show the cumulative term-deposit account balance (credit − debit) as of each year-end.
gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'C' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS net FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '2110' GROUP BY fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS year_end_balance FROM y ORDER BY fiscal_year

question_mn: Өнгөрсөн жилийн улирал бүрийн хүүгийн орлого тухайн жилийн нийт хүүгийн орлогын хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байсныг гарга.
question_latin: Ungursun jiliin uliral bvriin hvvgiin orlogo tuhain jiliin niit hvvgiin orlogiin heden huwiig ezelj baisniig garga.
question_en: What share of last year's total interest income did each quarter account for?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM posting_date)::int AS quarter, SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_income, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_mnt) / SUM(SUM(amount_mnt)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцэст 31–60 хоног хэтэрсэн байсан зээлүүд 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцэст ямар DPD бүлэгт байгааг тоолж гарга (агшинд байхгүй болсныг 'Агшинд байхгүй' гэж).
question_latin: 2025 onii 12-r sariin etsest 31-60 honog hetersen baisan zeelvvd 2026 onii 6-r sariin etsest yamar DPD bvlegt baigaag toolj garga (agshind baihgvi bolsniig 'Agshind baihgvi' gej).
question_en: For loans that were 31–60 days past due at end-December 2025, count where they stand by DPD bucket at end-June 2026 (label those missing from the snapshot 'Агшинд байхгүй').
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(b.dpd_bucket, 'Агшинд байхгүй') AS jun_2026_bucket, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a LEFT JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30' WHERE a.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31' AND a.dpd_bucket = 'DPD_31_60' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Сэрэмжлүүлэгтэй харилцагчдыг эрсдэлийн түвшингээр нь бүлэглээд, бүлэг бүрийн давхардаагүй харилцагчийн тоо, сэрэмжлүүлгийн нийт дүнг (төгрөгөөр, илэрсэн өдрийн ханшаар) гарга.
question_latin: Seremjlvvlegtei hariltsagchdiig ersdeliin tvwshingeer ni bvlegleed, bvleg bvriin dawhardaagvi hariltsagchiin too, seremjlvvlgiin niit dvng (tugrugoor, ilersen udriin hanshaar) garga.
question_en: Group customers with AML alerts by customer risk level and show the distinct customer count and total alert amount (MNT at detection-date rates) per group.
gold_sql: SELECT c.risk_level, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(a.alert_amount * t2s.fx_to_mnt(a.currency_code, a.detected_date)), 2) AS alert_amount_mnt FROM t2s.aml_alerts a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.risk_level

question_mn: 2025 оны жилийн эцсийн агшинд төгрөгийн зээлүүдийн нийт үлдэгдлийн хэдэн хувь нь 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээлд ногдож байсныг салбар бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii jiliin etssiin agshind tugrugiin zeelvvdiin niit vldegdliin heden huwi ni 30-aas deesh honog hetersen zeeld nogdoj baisniig salbar bvreer garga.
question_en: At the 2025 year-end snapshot, by branch, what percentage of the total outstanding of MNT loans was in loans more than 30 days past due?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(h.total_outstanding) FILTER (WHERE h.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(h.total_outstanding), 0), 2) AS dpd30_share_pct FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31' AND l.currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Snapshot has only total_outstanding, so the share is on total (not principal) outstanding; question states this explicitly.

question_mn: Одоо хаагдаагүй байгаа AML сэрэмжлүүлгүүд илэрснээсээ хойш дунджаар хэдэн хоног болж байгааг ноцтой байдлаар нь гарга.
question_latin: Odoo khaagdaagui baigaa AML seremjluulguud ilersnees khoish dundjaar kheden khonog bolj baigaag notstoi baidlaar ni garga.
question_en: By severity, how many days on average have the currently unclosed AML alerts been open since detection?
gold_sql: SELECT severity, ROUND(AVG(CURRENT_DATE - detected_date), 2) AS avg_days_open FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE closed_date IS NULL GROUP BY severity

question_mn: Ам.долларын идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт хэдэн доллар вэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin idevkhtei zeeluudiin undsen uldegdel niit kheden dollar ve?
question_en: What is the total outstanding principal of active USD loans, in dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(principal_outstanding) AS principal_outstanding_usd FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND currency_code = 'USD'

question_mn: Энэ онд бүрэн төлөгдөж хаагдсан зээл хэд вэ?
question_latin: Ene ond bvren tulugduj haagdsan zeel hed we
question_en: How many loans have been fully repaid and closed this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE status_code = 'CLOSED' AND closed_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Өнөөдөр хэдэн зээл олгосон бэ?
question_latin: Unuudur heden zeel olgoson be?
question_en: How many loans were disbursed today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date = CURRENT_DATE

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багц дахь хамгийн том зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл төгрөгөөр хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei bagts dakhi khamgiin tom zeeliin undsen uldegdel togrogoor khed ve?
question_en: What is the largest outstanding principal of a single loan in the active portfolio, in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS max_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Олгосон дүнгийнхээ талаас илүүг аль хэдийн төлж барагдуулсан идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Olgoson dvngiinhee talaas ilvvg ali hediin tulj baragduulsan idewhtei zeel hed baina?
question_en: How many active loans have already repaid more than half of the disbursed amount?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND principal_paid > 0.5 * disbursed_amount

question_mn: Зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүн тус бүрийн чанаргүй зээлийн хувь болон шаардлагатай эрсдэлийн сангийн хэмжээг гарга
question_latin: zeeliin bvteegdehvvn tus bvriin chanargvi zeeliin huwi bolon shaardlagatai ersdeliin sangiin hemjeeg garga
question_en: Show the NPL ratio and the required loan loss provision for each loan product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio, ROUND(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt * l.provision_rate / 100), 2) AS required_provision FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: KYC нь баталгаажаагүй хэрнээ идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй харилцагч хэд байна, тэдний зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: KYC ni batalgaajaagui khernee idevkhtei bagtsad zeeltei khariltsagch khed baina, tednii zeeliin undsen uldegdel niit khed ve?
question_en: How many customers whose KYC is not verified still have loans in the active portfolio, and what is their total outstanding principal?
question_mixed: KYC verified биш хэрнээ active portfolio-д зээлтэй customer хэд, тэдний outstanding principal хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND c.kyc_status <> 'VERIFIED'

question_mn: Валют бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг өөрийн валютаар болон төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Walyut bvreer idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdliig uuriin walyutaar bolon tugruguur garga
question_en: By currency, show the number of active loans and the outstanding principal both in the original currency and in MNT.
gold_sql: SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding) AS principal_outstanding, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY currency_code

question_mn: 2025 онд олгосон зээлүүдийн нэг зээлийн дундаж хэмжээг төгрөгөөр бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond olgoson zeeluudiin neg zeeliin dundaj khemjeeg togrogoor buteegdekhuunii torol bureer garga
question_en: Show the average size per loan, in MNT, of loans disbursed in 2025, by product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, ROUND(AVG(l.principal_amount_mnt), 2) AS avg_loan_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн нийт үлдэгдэл (хүү, торгууль, шимтгэл орсон) үндсэн үлдэгдлээсээ хэдэн хувиар их байгааг гарга
question_latin: salbar bvreer idewhtei zeeliin niit vldegdel (hvv, torguuli, shimtgel orson) vndsen vldegdleesee heden huwiar ih baigaag garga
question_en: For each branch, by what percentage does the total outstanding of active loans (including interest, penalties and fees) exceed the outstanding principal?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(l.total_outstanding_mnt) - SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS excess_over_principal_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: нийт үлдэгдэлд ирээдүйн хуваарийн хүү орно

question_mn: Эргэн төлөлтийн арга бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Ergen tulultiin arga bvreer idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdel bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: For each repayment (amortization) method, show the number of active loans, the outstanding principal and the PAR30.
gold_sql: SELECT amortization_type, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY amortization_type

question_mn: Өндөр хүүтэй зээл илүү эрсдэлтэй юу? Идэвхтэй зээлүүдийг жилийн хүүгээр нь 20 хүртэл, 20–30, 30–40, 40 ба түүнээс дээш хувь гэж ангилаад, ангилал бүрийн зээлийн тоо болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Ondor khuutei zeel iluu ersdeltei yuu? Idevkhtei zeeluudiig jiliin khuugeer ni 20 khurtel, 20-30, 30-40, 40 ba tuunees deesh khuvi gej angilaad, angilal buriin zeeliin too bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: Are higher-rate loans riskier? Classify active loans by annual interest rate (under 20, 20-30, 30-40, 40 percent and above) and show the number of loans and the PAR30 in each class.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN interest_rate < 20 THEN '20 хүртэл' WHEN interest_rate < 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN interest_rate < 40 THEN '30-40' ELSE '40+' END AS rate_band, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад 50-аас олон зээл хариуцаж байгаа зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдийн нэр, зээлийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsad 50-aas olon zeel hariutsaj baigaa zeeliin mergejiltnvvdiin ner, zeeliin toog garga
question_en: Show the names and loan counts of loan officers who manage more than 50 loans in the active portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = l.loan_officer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

question_mn: Зээлдэгчийн оршин суугаа аймаг, хот бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлтэй харилцагчийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: zeeldegchiin orshin suugaa aimag, khot bureer idevkhtei zeeltei khariltsagchiin too, undsen uldegdliig garga
question_en: By the borrower's province or city of residence, show the number of customers with active loans and the outstanding principal.
gold_sql: SELECT c.province, COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS borrowers, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.province

question_mn: Сүүлийн 3 сард (4, 5, 6-р сар) бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр хэдэн зээл, ямар дүнгээр олгосныг гарга
question_latin: Svvliin 3 sard (4, 5, 6-r sar) bvteegdehvvnii turul bvreer heden zeel, yamar dvngeer olgosniig garga
question_en: Over the last 3 months (April, May, June), show how many loans were disbursed and for what amount, by product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) AS disbursed_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 7–12-р сард сар бүр эцсийн төлөлтийн хугацаа нь болох идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 7-12-r sard sar bvr etssiin tulultiin hugatsaa ni boloh idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdliig garga
question_en: For each month from July to December 2026, show the number of active loans reaching final maturity and their outstanding principal.
question_mixed: 2026 оны 7–12-р сард month бүр maturity нь болох active зээлийн тоо, outstanding-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', maturity_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND maturity_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй зээлүүдийг хугацаагаар нь 12 сар хүртэл, 13–36 сар, 37–60 сар, 60-аас дээш сар гэж ангилж, ангилал бүрийн зээлийн тоо болон үлдэгдлээр жигнэсэн дундаж хүүг гарга
question_latin: Idevkhtei zeeluudiig khugatsaagaar ni 12 sar khurtel, 13-36 sar, 37-60 sar, 60-aas deesh sar gej angilj, angilal buriin zeeliin too bolon uldegdleer jignesen dundaj khuug garga
question_en: Classify active loans by term (up to 12 months, 13-36, 37-60, over 60 months) and show the number of loans and the outstanding-weighted average interest rate for each class.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN term_months <= 12 THEN '12 сар хүртэл' WHEN term_months <= 36 THEN '13-36 сар' WHEN term_months <= 60 THEN '37-60 сар' ELSE '60-аас дээш' END AS term_band, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(SUM(interest_rate * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS weighted_rate FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Тэтгэвэр авагч зээлдэгчдийн PAR30-ийг бусад хувь хүн зээлдэгчдийнхтэй харьцуулж гарга
question_latin: tetgewer awagch zeeldegchdiin PAR30-iig busad huwi hvn zeeldegchdiinhtei haritsuulj garga
question_en: Compare the PAR30 of pensioner borrowers with that of other individual borrowers.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_type_code = 'IND_PENSION' THEN 'Тэтгэвэр авагч' ELSE 'Бусад хувь хүн' END AS borrower_group, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND c.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн торгуулийн үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Salbar bureer idevkhtei zeeliin torguuliin uldegdliig togrogoor garga
question_en: Show the outstanding penalty of active loans in MNT for each branch.
question_mixed: Branch бүрээр active зээлийн penalty үлдэгдлийг MNT-ээр гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(SUM(l.penalty_outstanding * l.fx_rate_to_mnt), 2) AS penalty_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Сүүлийн төлөлт хийснээс хойш 60-аас олон хоног өнгөрсөн идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна? Огт төлөлт хийгээгүй зээлийг тооцохгүй.
question_latin: Svvliin tulult hiisnees hoish 60-aas olon honog ungursun idewhtei zeel hed baina? Ogt tulult hiigeegvi zeeliig tootsohgvi.
question_en: How many active loans have gone more than 60 days since their last payment? Exclude loans that have never made a payment.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND last_payment_date IS NOT NULL AND last_payment_date < CURRENT_DATE - 60

question_mn: Идэвхтэй барьцааных нь LTV 70%-иас давсан идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei baritsaaniih ni LTV 70%-ias dawsan idewhtei zeel hed baina?
question_en: How many active loans have an active collateral link with an LTV above 70%?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.loan_collaterals lc ON lc.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND lc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lc.ltv_ratio > 70
notes: нэг зээл олон барьцаатай байж болох тул DISTINCT

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр хэвийн, хяналтад, чанар муудсан болон чанаргүй ангиллын үндсэн үлдэгдлийг тус тусад нь гарга. Үлдэгдэлгүй ангилалд 0 гэж харуул.
question_latin: buteegdekhuunii torol bureer kheviin, khyanaltad, chanar muudsan bolon chanargui angilliin undsen uldegdliig tus tusad ni garga. Uldegdelgui angilald 0 gej kharuul.
question_en: By product type, show the outstanding principal in the normal, watch, substandard and non-performing classes separately; show 0 where a class has no balance.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'NORMAL'), 0) AS normal_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'WATCH'), 0) AS watch_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'), 0) AS substandard_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) AS npl_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцын эцсийн хугацаа хүртэл үлдсэн хоногийг үндсэн үлдэгдлээр жигнэсэн дунджийг гарга. Хугацаа нь аль хэдийн өнгөрсөн зээлийг 0 гэж тооцно.
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsiin etssiin hugatsaa hvrtel vldsen honogiig vndsen vldegdleer jignesen dundjiig garga. Hugatsaa ni ali hediin ungursun zeeliig 0 gej tootsno.
question_en: Calculate the outstanding-weighted average number of days remaining to maturity for the active portfolio, counting already-matured loans as 0.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(maturity_date - CURRENT_DATE, 0) * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS weighted_remaining_days FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Олгосон он бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн анх олгосон дүнгийн хэдэн хувь нь үндсэн үлдэгдэл хэлбэрээр төлөгдөөгүй байна вэ?
question_latin: Olgoson on bureer idevkhtei zeeluudiin ankh olgoson dungiin kheden khuvi ni undsen uldegdel khelbereer tologdoogui bn ve
question_en: By disbursement year, what percentage of the originally disbursed amount of active loans is still outstanding as principal?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM disbursement_date)::int AS disbursement_year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_amount_mnt), 0), 2) AS outstanding_pct FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцсийн агшинд бүртгэлтэй байсан идэвхтэй зээлийн тоог одоогийн идэвхтэй зээлийн тоотой харьцуулж, өсөлтийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: Salbar bvreer 2025 onii 12-r sariin etssiin agshind bvrtgeltei baisan idewhtei zeeliin toog odoogiin idewhtei zeeliin tootoi haritsuulj, usultiin huwiig garga
question_en: For each branch, compare the number of active loans in the end-of-December-2025 snapshot with the current number of active loans and show the growth percentage.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT l.branch_id, COUNT(*) AS loans_2025_12 FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY l.branch_id), n AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS loans_now FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, s.loans_2025_12, n.loans_now, ROUND(100.0 * (n.loans_now - s.loans_2025_12) / NULLIF(s.loans_2025_12, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM n JOIN s ON s.branch_id = n.branch_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = n.branch_id
notes: сарын эцсийн агшинд зөвхөн идэвхтэй зээл бичигддэг

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад 2 ба түүнээс олон зээлтэй зээлдэгч хэд байна, тэдний үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт багцын хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байна?
question_latin: idewhtei bagtsad 2 ba tvvnees olon zeeltei zeeldegch hed baina, tednii vndsen vldegdel niit bagtsiin heden huwiig ezelj baina?
question_en: How many borrowers have two or more loans in the active portfolio, and what share of the total portfolio principal do they hold?
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loans >= 2) AS multi_loan_borrowers, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(outstanding) FILTER (WHERE loans >= 2) / SUM(outstanding), 2) AS share_pct FROM b

question_mn: 2026 оны 3-р сарын эцсээс 6-р сарын эцсийн агшин хүртэл зээлүүд активын ангиллын хооронд хэрхэн шилжсэнийг өмнөх ангилал, шинэ ангилал, зээлийн тоогоор гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 3-r sariin etssees 6-r sariin etssiin agshin khurtel zeeluud aktiviin angilliin khoorond kherkhen shiljseniig omnokh angilal, shine angilal, zeeliin toogoor garga
question_en: Show how loans migrated between asset classifications from the end-of-March 2026 snapshot to the end-of-June 2026 snapshot: previous class, new class and number of loans.
gold_sql: SELECT a.classification_code AS class_2026_03, b.classification_code AS class_2026_06, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = '2026-06-30' WHERE a.snapshot_date = '2026-03-31' GROUP BY a.classification_code, b.classification_code
notes: хоёр агшинд хоёуланд нь байгаа зээлүүд

question_mn: 2025 оны 1-р улирлаас 2026 оны 2-р улирал хүртэл улирал бүрийн зээл олголтын дүн (төгрөгөөр) болон өмнөх улирлаас хэдэн хувиар өссөнийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii 1-r ulirlaas 2026 onii 2-r uliral hvrtel uliral bvriin zeel olgoltiin dvn (tugruguur) bolon umnuh ulirlaas heden huwiar ussuniig garga
question_en: From Q1 2025 to Q2 2026, show the loan disbursement amount (in MNT) for each quarter and its growth percentage from the previous quarter.
question_mixed: 2025 Q1-ээс 2026 Q2 хүртэл quarter бүрийн disbursement дүн болон QoQ growth %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', disbursement_date)::date AS quarter_start, SUM(principal_amount_mnt) AS disbursed_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT quarter_start, disbursed_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * (disbursed_mnt - LAG(disbursed_mnt) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(disbursed_mnt) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 0), 2) AS qoq_growth_pct FROM q) SELECT quarter_start, disbursed_mnt, qoq_growth_pct FROM g WHERE quarter_start >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY quarter_start

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр энэ оны эхний хагаст олгосон зээлийн олгосон дүнгээр жигнэсэн дундаж хүүг өнгөрсөн оны мөн үеийнхтэй харьцуулж, өөрчлөлтийг нэгж хувиар гарга
question_latin: Buteegdekhuunii torol bureer ene onii ekhnii khagast olgoson zeeliin olgoson dungeer jignesen dundaj khuug ongorson onii mon ueiinkhtei kharitsuulj, oorchloltiig negj khuviar garga
question_en: By product type, compare the disbursement-weighted average interest rate of loans disbursed in the first half of this year with the same period last year, and show the change in percentage points.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.product_type_name, SUM(l.interest_rate * l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30') / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'), 0) AS rate_h1_2025, SUM(l.interest_rate * l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'), 0) AS rate_h1_2026 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' OR l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.product_type_name) SELECT product_type_name, ROUND(rate_h1_2025, 2) AS rate_h1_2025, ROUND(rate_h1_2026, 2) AS rate_h1_2026, ROUND(rate_h1_2026 - rate_h1_2025, 2) AS change_pp FROM r

question_mn: Хамгийн сүүлийн зээлээ 2024 онд авсан, одоо идэвхтэй зээлгүй байгаа харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Hamgiin svvliin zeelee 2024 ond awsan, odoo idewhtei zeelgvi baigaa hariltsagch hed we?
